| **V04.13** Offboard / Retire Employee | Employee, Superannuation / Pension Fund, Benefits Provider | Human Resources (employee relations adviser), Payroll (payroll officer), IT (IT provisioning officer) | HRIS / HCM System |

**Actor / Team / System roll-up** (every distinct participant across V04):

- **External actors:** Applicant / Candidate (V04.03–V04.05); Employee (V04.06–V04.13); Recruitment Agency (V04.03); Referee (V04.04); Background Check Provider (V04.05); Training Provider (V04.10); Benefits Provider (V04.06, V04.08, V04.13); Superannuation / Pension Fund (V04.06, V04.08, V04.13).
- **Teams:** Human Resources (V04.01, V04.05, V04.06, V04.09, V04.11, V04.12, V04.13); Recruitment (V04.02–V04.05); Hiring Manager / People Manager (V04.01, V04.02, V04.04, V04.09, V04.11, V04.12); Learning & Development (V04.10); Payroll (V04.06, V04.08, V04.11, V04.12, V04.13); Finance (V04.01, V04.08); IT (V04.07, V04.13); Facilities (V04.07); Legal (V04.05).
- **IT systems:** HRIS / HCM System (V04.01, V04.05, V04.06, V04.11, V04.13); Applicant Tracking System (V04.02, V04.03, V04.04); Payroll System (V04.08); Learning Management System (V04.10); Identity & Access Management (IAM) System (V04.07); Workforce Management System (V04.12); Performance Management System (V04.09).

**ArchiMate diagram prompt.**

A single high-level ArchiMate view of the Hire to Retire service area. It shows
the **Actors**, **Services**, **Processes**, **Interfaces** and **Applications**
that provide the Recruitment & Selection Service and the related people services
across the thirteen V04 processes. Each Business Process is a drill-down anchor:
link it to the matching V04.nn BPMN diagram and its marker turns green.

```text
ArchiMate: V04 — Hire to Retire — Service & Application Landscape (high level).

Purpose: show how the organisation provides the workforce and employment
services (to the internal managers, to the Applicant / Candidate and to the
Employee) across the thirteen V04 Hire to Retire processes, and the
applications that support them. Lay it out in three horizontal bands, top to
bottom — BUSINESS SERVICES → BUSINESS PROCESSES → APPLICATIONS — with the
Applicant / Candidate on the far left and the Employee and provider actors on
the far right. Read top-to-bottom as service → process → application (ArchiMate
service realisation).

1. Business Actors (Business Actor)
- Applicant / Candidate — the external party the recruitment service is
  provided to (far left, the party who applies for the vacancy).
- Employee — the person the ongoing employment service is provided to (once
  hired), centre-right of the view.
- Recruitment Agency, Referee, Background Check Provider, Training Provider,
  Benefits Provider, Superannuation / Pension Fund — external actors that take
  part in sourcing, vetting, development and the employment relationship (far
  right).

2. Interfaces
- Business Interface "Careers Portal / Employee Self-Service" — the channel the
  Applicant / Candidate uses to view vacancies and apply, and the Employee uses
  to self-serve pay, leave and personal details. The Applicant / Candidate and
  Employee ACCESS this interface; the interface SERVES the business services
  below.
- Application Interfaces (optional, only the few the portal calls): "Recruitment
  API" on the Applicant Tracking System, "Payroll API" on the Payroll System.

3. Business Services (Business Service) — the services provided, top band,
   left-to-right in employee-lifecycle order:
- Workforce Planning Service — plan roles, headcount and budget.
- Recruitment & Selection Service — advertise, attract, assess and select.
- Offer & Onboarding Service — offer, onboard and provision the new hire.
- Pay & Benefits Service — pay the employee and manage benefits.
- Performance & Development Service — manage performance and develop the
  employee.
- Change & Leave Service — manage employment changes and leave / absence.
- Offboarding & Retirement Service — offboard and retire the employee.

4. Business Processes (Business Process) — the thirteen V04 processes, middle
   band in V04.01 → V04.13 order. Each REALISES the business service shown and is
   the link anchor to its BPMN diagram:
- V04.01 Workforce Planning                 -> realises Workforce Planning Service
- V04.02 Create Vacancy                     -> realises Recruitment & Selection Service
- V04.03 Attract Candidates                 -> realises Recruitment & Selection Service
- V04.04 Assess and Interview Candidates    -> realises Recruitment & Selection Service
- V04.05 Make Offer                         -> realises Offer & Onboarding Service
- V04.06 Onboard Employee                   -> realises Offer & Onboarding Service
- V04.07 Provision Access / Equipment       -> realises Offer & Onboarding Service
- V04.08 Manage Payroll and Benefits        -> realises Pay & Benefits Service
- V04.09 Manage Performance                 -> realises Performance & Development Service
- V04.10 Develop Employee                   -> realises Performance & Development Service
- V04.11 Manage Changes                     -> realises Change & Leave Service
- V04.12 Handle Leave / Absence             -> realises Change & Leave Service
- V04.13 Offboard / Retire Employee         -> realises Offboarding & Retirement Service

5. Applications (Application Component) — the IT systems that support the
   processes, bottom band:
- HRIS / HCM System
- Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
- Payroll System
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Identity & Access Management (IAM) System
- Workforce Management System
- Performance Management System

6. Relationships
- Applicant / Candidate -accesses-> Careers Portal / Employee Self-Service.
- Employee -accesses-> Careers Portal / Employee Self-Service.
- Careers Portal / Employee Self-Service -serving-> the Recruitment,
  Onboarding, Pay and Leave services.
- Each Business Process -realisation-> its Business Service (section 4).
- Each Business Process -served by-> its supporting Application Component
  (serving, application -> process):
    V04.01 <- HRIS / HCM System;            V04.02 <- Applicant Tracking System;
    V04.03 <- Applicant Tracking System;    V04.04 <- Applicant Tracking System;
    V04.05 <- HRIS / HCM System;            V04.06 <- HRIS / HCM System;
    V04.07 <- Identity & Access Management (IAM) System;
    V04.08 <- Payroll System;               V04.09 <- Performance Management System;
    V04.10 <- Learning Management System;   V04.11 <- HRIS / HCM System;
    V04.12 <- Workforce Management System;  V04.13 <- HRIS / HCM System.
- Recruitment Agency -serving-> V04.03 Attract Candidates.
- Referee -serving-> V04.04 Assess and Interview Candidates.
- Background Check Provider -serving-> V04.05 Make Offer.
- Training Provider -serving-> V04.10 Develop Employee.
- Benefits Provider and Superannuation / Pension Fund -serving-> V04.06 Onboard
  Employee, V04.08 Manage Payroll and Benefits, and V04.13 Offboard / Retire
  Employee.

7. Intent
The Recruitment & Selection Service sits top-centre-left as the headline
attraction service, with the employment services running to its right. The
thirteen Business Processes form the backbone in V04.01 -> V04.13 order so the
reader can trace the employee lifecycle and drill from any process straight into
its detailed BPMN model. This one ArchiMate view therefore links to all thirteen
V04 BPMN process diagrams. The mapping of process -> actors/teams/applications is
the Process <-> Actors / Teams / IT Systems matrix above.
```

### V04.01 — Workforce Planning

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V04.01 Workforce Planning — the opening subprocess of the Hire to
Retire value chain, in which the organisation identifies workforce gaps,
builds a headcount plan, and obtains budget approval before any vacancy
is created.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Employing Organisation" — the organisation running the workforce
planning process, containing three lanes top to bottom.
  Lane "Hiring Manager / People Manager" — the people manager who
    identifies team needs and submits headcount requests.
  Lane "Human Resources" — the HR business partner who consolidates
    demand, validates against workforce data, and coordinates approval.
  Lane "Finance" — the finance controller who reviews the business case
    and authorises budget.
Pool "HRIS / HCM System" — the HR information and human capital
management platform that holds employee master data and provides
workforce reports.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Employing Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "HRIS / HCM System" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Employing Organisation (white-box, lanes top to bottom: Hiring
   Manager / People Manager, Human Resources, Finance)
2. HRIS / HCM System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Employing Organisation)

Hiring Manager / People Manager lane:
  None start event "Annual planning cycle or ad-hoc trigger received"
  User task "Identify team headcount needs and skill gaps"
  User task "Document headcount request and business justification"
  Send task "Submit headcount request to Human Resources"

Human Resources lane:
  Intermediate message catch event "Headcount request received"
  Service task "Retrieve current workforce data from HRIS / HCM System"
  User task "Consolidate headcount requests across all business units"
  User task "Analyse workforce gaps against strategic plan"
  Exclusive gateway "Sufficient information to build plan?"
    - branch "No — information incomplete": Expanded Subprocess "Repeat
      Until Request Details Complete" (standard loop) containing, in
      order: User task "Request clarification from Hiring Manager /
      People Manager", Intermediate message catch event "Clarification
      received"
      (exits subprocess)
    - branch "Yes — information sufficient": (continues to exclusive
      merge gateway "Sufficient information to build plan?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Sufficient information to build plan?"
  User task "Prepare workforce plan and headcount proposal"
  User task "Prepare business case for budget approval"
  Send task "Submit business case to Finance for approval"

Finance lane:
  Intermediate message catch event "Business case received"
  User task "Review business case and headcount cost model"
  Exclusive gateway "Budget approved?"
    - branch "No — rejected or deferred": User task "Document rejection
      reason and notify Human Resources"
      End event "Headcount request rejected — no vacancy created"
    - branch "Yes — approved": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Budget approved?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Budget approved?"
  User task "Record budget approval and allocate headcount funding"
  Send task "Notify Human Resources of approved headcount"

Human Resources lane (continued):
  Intermediate message catch event "Budget approval notification
    received"
  User task "Update workforce plan with approved headcount positions"
  Service task "Record approved positions in HRIS / HCM System"
  End event "Approved workforce plan confirmed — ready for Create
    Vacancy"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Timer boundary event (interrupting) on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat
Until Request Details Complete" — label "Clarification overdue after
10 business days" — on trigger, flow continues to: User task "Escalate
outstanding request to HR business partner" followed by End event
"Request escalated — workforce planning on hold".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: work begins in the Hiring Manager / People Manager lane,
passes by message to the Human Resources lane, which loops until
information is complete before continuing to produce the business case,
then passes by message to the Finance lane for budget review; the
"Budget approved?" gateway splits to a rejection end event or, on
approval, continues back to the Human Resources lane where the plan is
finalised and recorded.

Message flows:
HRIS / HCM System → Human Resources lane, Service task "Retrieve
  current workforce data from HRIS / HCM System" (current employee
  master data and workforce reports).
Human Resources lane, Service task "Record approved positions in
  HRIS / HCM System" → HRIS / HCM System (approved headcount
  positions and updated workforce plan).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Headcount Request" — written by User task "Document
  headcount request and business justification"; read by User task
  "Consolidate headcount requests across all business units".
Data Object "Workforce Gap Analysis" — written by User task "Analyse
  workforce gaps against strategic plan"; read by User task "Prepare
  workforce plan and headcount proposal".
Data Object "Workforce Plan" — written by User task "Prepare workforce
  plan and headcount proposal"; read by User task "Prepare business case
  for budget approval" and User task "Update workforce plan with approved
  headcount positions".
Data Object "Business Case" — written by User task "Prepare business
  case for budget approval"; read by User task "Review business case and
  headcount cost model".
Data Object "Budget Approval Record" — written by User task "Record
  budget approval and allocate headcount funding"; read by Service task
  "Record approved positions in HRIS / HCM System".

Workforce Planning translates strategic people needs into a set of
budget-approved headcount positions, validating demand from hiring
managers, resolving information gaps, and securing Finance sign-off.
It hands an approved workforce plan, with funded positions recorded in
the HRIS / HCM System, to Create Vacancy, which will raise individual
job requisitions against those approved slots.
```

### V04.02 — Create Vacancy

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V04.02 Create Vacancy — the second subprocess in the Hire to
Retire value chain, converting an approved workforce need into a
published vacancy record ready for candidate attraction.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Employing Organisation" — the organisation creating and
approving the vacancy, with lanes for the teams involved.
  Lanes (top to bottom):
  - Hiring Manager / People Manager (hiring manager)
  - Recruitment (recruiter)
Pool "Applicant Tracking System" — IT system used to create and
publish the vacancy record.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Employing Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Applicant Tracking System" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Employing Organisation (white-box, contains process flow)
2. Applicant Tracking System (black-box, IT system)

4. Lane contents in flow order (Employing Organisation)

Hiring Manager / People Manager lane:
  Message start event "Approved headcount request received from
    Workforce Planning"
  User task "Draft job description and person specification"
  User task "Review and approve job description"
  Exclusive gateway "Job description approved?"
    - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
        "Job description approved")
    - branch "No": User task "Revise job description"
        (continues to exclusive merge gateway
        "Job description approved")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Job description approved"
  Send task "Submit approved job description to Recruitment"

Recruitment lane:
  User task "Review job description and determine sourcing
    strategy"
  User task "Prepare vacancy details and advertisement copy"
  Exclusive gateway "Internal posting required?"
    - branch "Yes": User task "Post vacancy on internal channels"
        (continues to exclusive merge gateway
        "Internal posting required")
    - branch "No": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
        "Internal posting required")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Internal posting required"
  Service task "Create vacancy record in Applicant Tracking
    System"
  Service task "Publish external job advertisement via Applicant
    Tracking System"
  Intermediate message catch event "Vacancy confirmed live in
    Applicant Tracking System"
  End event "Vacancy live — ready for Attract Candidates"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on "Create vacancy record in
Applicant Tracking System" — label "ATS timeout (15 min)" —
flows to End event "Vacancy creation failed — recruiter to
investigate".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: work begins in the Hiring Manager / People
Manager lane with the approved headcount request, passes through
job description drafting, approval, and the "Job description
approved?" gateway whose branches (approve or revise) both
rejoin at the "Job description approved" merge gateway before
the hiring manager submits to Recruitment. In the Recruitment
lane the recruiter reviews, prepares advertisement copy, takes
the "Internal posting required?" gateway whose branches rejoin
at the "Internal posting required" merge gateway, then creates
and publishes the vacancy via the Applicant Tracking System,
waits for confirmation, and the process ends.

Message flows:
Applicant Tracking System → "Create vacancy record in Applicant
  Tracking System" (vacancy record creation confirmation)
"Publish external job advertisement via Applicant Tracking
  System" → Applicant Tracking System (advertisement data and
  publication instruction)
Applicant Tracking System → Intermediate message catch event
  "Vacancy confirmed live in Applicant Tracking System"
  (live vacancy confirmation)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Approved Headcount Request" — read by "Draft job
  description and person specification".
Data Object "Job Description and Person Specification" — written
  by "Draft job description and person specification"; read by
  "Review and approve job description"; read by "Revise job
  description"; read by "Review job description and determine
  sourcing strategy".
Data Object "Sourcing Strategy" — written by "Review job
  description and determine sourcing strategy"; read by "Prepare
  vacancy details and advertisement copy".
Data Object "Advertisement Copy" — written by "Prepare vacancy
  details and advertisement copy"; read by "Publish external job
  advertisement via Applicant Tracking System".
Data Object "Vacancy Record" — written by "Create vacancy record
  in Applicant Tracking System"; read by "Publish external job
  advertisement via Applicant Tracking System".

V04.02 Create Vacancy takes the approved headcount request
produced by Workforce Planning and converts it into a live,
published vacancy. The hiring manager drafts and approves the
job description, Recruitment builds the sourcing strategy and
advertisement copy, and the recruiter creates and publishes the
vacancy record through the Applicant Tracking System. The
confirmed live vacancy is then handed to Attract Candidates so
that applications can begin to flow.
```

### V04.03 — Attract Candidates

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V04.03 Attract Candidates — the subprocess that publishes vacancies,
receives applications, and passes screened candidate records to Assess and
Interview Candidates.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Employing Organisation" — the organisation running the attraction and
  initial screening process, with lanes for Recruitment.
Pool "Applicant / Candidate" — external individual who sees job
  advertisements and submits applications.
Pool "Recruitment Agency" — external party that sources and refers
  candidates on behalf of the organisation.
Pool "Applicant Tracking System" — IT system that hosts vacancy
  postings, receives applications, and holds candidate records.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Employing Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Applicant / Candidate" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Recruitment Agency" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Applicant Tracking System" — black-box, System = true,
  single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Applicant / Candidate
2. Recruitment Agency
3. Employing Organisation
4. Applicant Tracking System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Employing Organisation)

Recruitment lane:
  Message start event "Approved vacancy received from Create Vacancy"
  User task "Prepare job advertisement and channel plan"
  Service task "Publish vacancy to job boards and careers site"
  Send task "Send vacancy brief to recruitment agency"
  Intermediate message catch event "Applications and referrals received"
  User task "Import and deduplicate applications in ATS"
  Service task "Record all candidate submissions in ATS"
  Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Screening Complete" (standard loop)
    containing, in order: User task "Review application against
    criteria", User task "Score and categorise candidate",
    Exclusive gateway "Meets minimum criteria?"
    - branch "Yes": User task "Move candidate to longlist"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Meets minimum
      criteria")
    - branch "No": Send task "Send regret notification to
      candidate" (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Meets
      minimum criteria")
    Exclusive merge gateway "Meets minimum criteria"
  User task "Compile shortlist for hiring manager review"
  User task "Obtain hiring manager approval of shortlist"
  Exclusive gateway "Shortlist approved?"
  - branch "Approved": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
    "Shortlist approved")
  - branch "Not approved": User task "Revise shortlist based on
    feedback" (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Shortlist
    approved")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Shortlist approved"
  Service task "Update candidate statuses in ATS"
  End event "Shortlisted candidates confirmed — ready for Assess
    and Interview Candidates"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
  Screening Complete", labelled "Screening deadline elapsed"; on trigger,
  flow continues to User task "Compile shortlist for hiring manager
  review" with candidates screened so far.

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: The single Recruitment lane carries all flow in order
  from the message start event through advertisement preparation,
  publication, and agency briefing, then waits for the intermediate
  message catch event before importing applications into the ATS and
  entering the screening loop. Within the loop, the exclusive gateway
  "Meets minimum criteria?" branches to longlist or regret notification,
  both rejoining at the exclusive merge gateway "Meets minimum criteria"
  before the loop repeats. After the loop, flow continues through
  shortlist compilation and the "Shortlist approved?" gateway; the "Not
  approved" branch loops back through revision and rejoins at the
  exclusive merge gateway "Shortlist approved", after which the ATS
  status update leads to the end event.

Message flows:
  Employing Organisation (Service task "Publish vacancy to job boards
    and careers site") → Applicant / Candidate (job advertisement)
  Employing Organisation (Send task "Send vacancy brief to recruitment
    agency") → Recruitment Agency (vacancy brief)
  Applicant / Candidate → Employing Organisation (Intermediate message
    catch event "Applications and referrals received") (resume and
    application)
  Recruitment Agency → Employing Organisation (Intermediate message
    catch event "Applications and referrals received") (referred
    candidate submissions)
  Employing Organisation (Service task "Record all candidate submissions
    in ATS") → Applicant Tracking System (candidate submission records)
  Applicant Tracking System → Employing Organisation (Service task
    "Import and deduplicate applications in ATS") (deduplicated
    application data)
  Employing Organisation (Service task "Update candidate statuses in
    ATS") → Applicant Tracking System (updated candidate status records)
  Employing Organisation (Send task "Send regret notification to
    candidate") → Applicant / Candidate (regret notification)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Job Advertisement" — written by User task "Prepare job
  advertisement and channel plan"; read by Service task "Publish vacancy
  to job boards and careers site".
Data Object "Vacancy Brief" — written by User task "Prepare job
  advertisement and channel plan"; read by Send task "Send vacancy brief
  to recruitment agency".
Data Object "Candidate Application" — written by User task "Import and
  deduplicate applications in ATS"; read by User task "Review
  application against criteria".
Data Object "Longlist" — written by User task "Move candidate to
  longlist"; read by User task "Compile shortlist for hiring manager
  review".
Data Object "Shortlist" — written by User task "Compile shortlist for
  hiring manager review"; read by User task "Obtain hiring manager
  approval of shortlist".

This subprocess takes an approved vacancy from Create Vacancy, publishes it
across job boards and the organisation's careers site, briefs any engaged
recruitment agency, collects all applications and referrals, screens them
against minimum criteria, and assembles a hiring-manager-approved shortlist.
It hands that confirmed shortlist — with candidate records updated in the
Applicant Tracking System — to Assess and Interview Candidates, where the
detailed evaluation and interviewing work begins.
```

### V04.04 — Assess and Interview Candidates

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V04.04 Assess and Interview Candidates — the fourth subprocess in
the Hire to Retire value chain, receiving shortlisted candidates from
Attract Candidates and handing confirmed outcomes to Make Offer.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Employing Organisation" — the organisation conducting assessment
  and interviews, with lanes for Recruitment and Hiring Manager /
  People Manager.
Pool "Applicant / Candidate" — external individual being assessed and
  interviewed.
Pool "Referee" — external individual providing a reference for the
  candidate.
Pool "Applicant Tracking System" — IT system recording candidate
  assessments, interview outcomes, and status updates.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Employing Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Applicant / Candidate" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Referee" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Applicant Tracking System" — black-box, System = true,
  single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Applicant / Candidate
2. Employing Organisation
3. Referee
4. Applicant Tracking System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Employing Organisation)

Recruitment lane:
  Message start event "Shortlisted candidate received from
    Attract Candidates"
  Service task "Retrieve candidate shortlist from Applicant
    Tracking System"
  User task "Schedule assessments and interviews"
  Send task "Send assessment instructions and interview
    invitation to candidate"
  Intermediate message catch event "Candidate confirms
    availability"
  User task "Configure assessment tasks and scorecards"
  Service task "Record scheduled interviews in Applicant
    Tracking System"
  Parallel gateway "Conduct assessment activities"
    - branch "Assessment": User task "Administer candidate
        assessment"
        (continues to parallel merge gateway "Assessment
        activities complete")
    - branch "Reference check": Send task "Send reference
        request to referee"
        Intermediate message catch event "Reference response
        received"
        User task "Review and record reference feedback"
        (continues to parallel merge gateway "Assessment
        activities complete")
  Parallel merge gateway "Assessment activities complete"
  User task "Collate assessment results and scorecards"
  Service task "Update candidate assessment status in Applicant
    Tracking System"
  Exclusive gateway "Assessment outcome?"
    - branch "Does not meet threshold": Send task "Send
        regret notification to candidate"
        Service task "Record rejection in Applicant Tracking
        System"
        End event "Candidate rejected — assessment stage
        closed"
    - branch "Meets threshold": User task "Prepare interview
        pack and share with hiring manager"
        (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Assessment
        outcome")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Assessment outcome"
  Exclusive gateway "Interviews complete?"
    - branch "No — further rounds required":
        Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until All Interview Rounds
        Complete" (standard loop) containing, in order:
          User task "Schedule next interview round"
          Send task "Send interview invitation to candidate"
          Intermediate message catch event "Candidate confirms
          next round availability"
          (exits subprocess)
    - branch "Yes": User task "Compile final interview
        evaluation summary"
        (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Interviews
        complete")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Interviews complete"
  Service task "Record final interview status in Applicant
    Tracking System"
  Exclusive gateway "Overall outcome decision?"
    - branch "Unsuccessful": Send task "Send final regret
        notification to candidate"
        Service task "Record final rejection in Applicant
        Tracking System"
        End event "Candidate not selected — process closed"
    - branch "Proceed to offer": End event "Candidate
        approved — ready for Make Offer"
  Exclusive merge gateway "Overall outcome decision" — note:
    only the "Proceed to offer" branch reaches this merge;
    the "Unsuccessful" branch ends at its own End event above.

Hiring Manager / People Manager lane:
  User task "Conduct structured interview"
  User task "Complete interview scorecard"
  User task "Participate in debrief and panel discussion"
  User task "Confirm interview recommendation to Recruitment"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat
  Until All Interview Rounds Complete" — label "Interview scheduling
  deadline exceeded" — triggers End event "Interview process timed
  out — candidate withdrawn".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: Flow begins in the Recruitment lane with the message
start event, moves through shortlist retrieval, scheduling, and
invitation tasks, pauses at the candidate availability catch event,
then enters the parallel gateway splitting into the assessment branch
and the reference check branch; both branches rejoin at the parallel
merge gateway. Flow continues through collation and the assessment
outcome exclusive gateway: the rejection branch ends immediately; the
passing branch leads to interview pack preparation and rejoins at the
exclusive merge gateway. Flow then enters the interviews-complete
exclusive gateway: the looping branch enters the standard-loop
subprocess and exits back to the gateway; the completing branch moves
to final evaluation summary and rejoins at the second exclusive merge
gateway. Final evaluation reaches the overall-outcome exclusive
gateway: the unsuccessful branch ends immediately; the proceed branch
reaches the closing end event. Interview-related tasks in the Hiring
Manager / People Manager lane connect in sequence — conduct interview,
complete scorecard, debrief, confirm recommendation — and link to the
Recruitment lane at the collation task.

Message flows:
Employing Organisation (Send task "Send assessment instructions and
  interview invitation to candidate") → Applicant / Candidate
  (assessment instructions and interview invitation)
Applicant / Candidate → Employing Organisation (Intermediate message
  catch event "Candidate confirms availability") (availability
  confirmation)
Employing Organisation (Send task "Send reference request to
  referee") → Referee (reference request)
Referee → Employing Organisation (Intermediate message catch event
  "Reference response received") (completed reference)
Employing Organisation (Send task "Send interview invitation to
  candidate") → Applicant / Candidate (interview round invitation)
Applicant / Candidate → Employing Organisation (Intermediate message
  catch event "Candidate confirms next round availability")
  (next-round availability confirmation)
Employing Organisation (Send task "Send regret notification to
  candidate") → Applicant / Candidate (regret notification —
  assessment stage)
Employing Organisation (Send task "Send final regret notification to
  candidate") → Applicant / Candidate (final regret notification)
Employing Organisation (Service task "Retrieve candidate shortlist
  from Applicant Tracking System") → Applicant Tracking System
  (shortlist retrieval request)
Applicant Tracking System → Employing Organisation (Service task
  "Retrieve candidate shortlist from Applicant Tracking System")
  (shortlisted candidate records)
Employing Organisation (Service task "Record scheduled interviews in
  Applicant Tracking System") → Applicant Tracking System
  (interview schedule)
Employing Organisation (Service task "Update candidate assessment
  status in Applicant Tracking System") → Applicant Tracking System
  (assessment result and status)
Employing Organisation (Service task "Record rejection in Applicant
  Tracking System") → Applicant Tracking System (rejection record)
Employing Organisation (Service task "Record final interview status
  in Applicant Tracking System") → Applicant Tracking System
  (final interview outcome)
Employing Organisation (Service task "Record final rejection in
  Applicant Tracking System") → Applicant Tracking System
  (final rejection record)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Candidate Shortlist" — read by "Retrieve candidate
  shortlist from Applicant Tracking System"; read by "Prepare
  interview pack and share with hiring manager".
Data Object "Interview Schedule" — written by "Schedule assessments
  and interviews"; read by "Send assessment instructions and
  interview invitation to candidate"; read by "Record scheduled
  interviews in Applicant Tracking System".
Data Object "Assessment Scorecard" — written by "Administer candidate
  assessment"; written by "Complete interview scorecard"; read by
  "Collate assessment results and scorecards".
Data Object "Reference Feedback" — written by "Review and record
  reference feedback"; read by "Collate assessment results and
  scorecards".
Data Object "Interview Pack" — written by "Prepare interview pack and
  share with hiring manager"; read by "Conduct structured interview".
Data Object "Final Interview Evaluation Summary" — written by
  "Compile final interview evaluation summary"; read by "Record final
  interview status in Applicant Tracking System".

This subprocess takes shortlisted candidates from Attract Candidates,
coordinates structured assessments, reference checks, and one or more
interview rounds, and records all outcomes in the Applicant Tracking
System. Candidates who do not meet the threshold receive a regret
notification and the process closes for them; candidates who succeed
through all rounds are confirmed as approved and passed to Make Offer
with a completed evaluation summary ready to support the offer
decision.
```

### V04.05 — Make Offer

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V04.05 Make Offer — the subprocess in the Hire to Retire value
chain that converts a successful candidate assessment into a signed employment
contract and a cleared background check, ready for onboarding.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Employing Organisation" — the organisation running the Make Offer process,
containing the Recruitment, Human Resources, and Legal lanes.
Pool "Applicant / Candidate" — the individual receiving and responding to
the offer.
Pool "Background Check Provider" — the external agency that carries out
pre-employment screening.
Pool "HRIS / HCM System" — the system of record for employee master data
and contracts.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Employing Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Applicant / Candidate" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Background Check Provider" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "HRIS / HCM System" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Applicant / Candidate
2. Employing Organisation
3. Background Check Provider
4. HRIS / HCM System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Employing Organisation)

Recruitment lane:
  Message start event "Successful candidate identified from Assess and
    Interview Candidates"
  User task "Prepare preliminary offer details"
  User task "Submit offer for HR approval"

Human Resources lane:
  User task "Review and approve offer terms"
  Exclusive gateway "Offer terms approved?"
  - branch "No — revise terms": User task "Return offer details to
    Recruitment with feedback"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Offer terms approved")
  - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Offer terms
    approved")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Offer terms approved"
  User task "Generate offer letter and employment contract"
  Send task "Send offer letter and contract to candidate"
  Intermediate message catch event "Candidate response received"
  Exclusive gateway "Candidate accepts offer?"
  - branch "Declined": User task "Record offer declined and notify
    Recruitment"
    End event "Offer declined — candidate returns to talent pool or
    vacancy reopens"
  - branch "Accepted": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Candidate
    accepts offer")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Candidate accepts offer"
  User task "Initiate background check"
  Send task "Send background check request to provider"
  Intermediate message catch event "Background check result received"
  Exclusive gateway "Background check cleared?"
  - branch "Failed / Adverse finding": User task "Notify hiring manager
    and review outcome"
    Exclusive gateway "Proceed despite finding?"
    - branch "Withdraw offer": User task "Issue offer withdrawal
      notification to candidate"
      End event "Offer withdrawn — vacancy may be reopened"
    - branch "Accept with conditions": (continues to exclusive merge
      gateway "Proceed despite finding")
    Exclusive merge gateway "Proceed despite finding"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Background check cleared")
  - branch "Cleared": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Background
    check cleared")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Background check cleared"
  User task "Confirm start date and employment conditions with candidate"
  Send task "Send confirmed contract and onboarding instructions to
    candidate"

Legal lane:
  User task "Review contract for legal compliance"
  User task "Approve contract wording"

Human Resources lane (continued, after Legal sign-off):
  Service task "Record accepted offer and employee record in HRIS / HCM"
  End event "Offer accepted and employee record created — ready for
    Onboard Employee"

Note on flow: after "Generate offer letter and employment contract" in the
Human Resources lane, the contract is passed to the Legal lane for "Review
contract for legal compliance" and "Approve contract wording" before
returning to the Human Resources lane for "Send offer letter and contract
to candidate".

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Intermediate message catch event
"Candidate response received" — label "Response deadline elapsed (e.g.
5 business days)" — if no candidate response is received within the
allowed period, flow continues to User task "Chase candidate for response"
in the Human Resources lane, after which flow loops back to the
Intermediate message catch event "Candidate response received" or,
if still no response, to End event "Offer lapsed — no candidate response".

Interrupting timer boundary event on Intermediate message catch event
"Background check result received" — label "Background check overdue
(e.g. 10 business days)" — triggers User task "Follow up with Background
Check Provider" in the Human Resources lane, returning to the
Intermediate message catch event "Background check result received".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: flow begins in the Recruitment lane with the message start
event, moves to the Human Resources lane for approval, loops back to
Recruitment via the "No — revise terms" branch of the "Offer terms
approved?" gateway before merging and continuing in Human Resources;
the contract moves to the Legal lane for review and approval, then
returns to Human Resources for despatch to the candidate; after the
candidate-acceptance gateway, the declined branch ends independently;
the accepted branch continues through background-check steps, with the
adverse-finding nested gateway either ending at offer withdrawal or
merging back to the cleared path; the cleared path ends with HRIS/HCM
recording and the final end event.

Message flows:
Human Resources lane "Send offer letter and contract to candidate" →
  Applicant / Candidate (offer letter and draft employment contract).
Applicant / Candidate → Human Resources lane Intermediate message catch
  event "Candidate response received" (signed or declined response).
Human Resources lane "Send background check request to provider" →
  Background Check Provider (background check request with candidate
  consent and personal details).
Background Check Provider → Human Resources lane Intermediate message
  catch event "Background check result received" (screening report and
  clearance status).
Human Resources lane "Issue offer withdrawal notification to candidate" →
  Applicant / Candidate (offer withdrawal letter).
Human Resources lane "Send confirmed contract and onboarding instructions
  to candidate" → Applicant / Candidate (signed confirmed contract and
  onboarding welcome pack).
Human Resources lane "Record accepted offer and employee record in
  HRIS / HCM" → HRIS / HCM System (new employee master record, contract
  details, confirmed start date).
HRIS / HCM System → Human Resources lane (employee record confirmation
  and unique employee identifier).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Preliminary Offer Details" — written by User task "Prepare
  preliminary offer details"; read by User task "Review and approve offer
  terms".
Data Object "Offer Letter and Employment Contract" — written by User task
  "Generate offer letter and employment contract"; read by User task
  "Review contract for legal compliance", User task "Approve contract
  wording", Send task "Send offer letter and contract to candidate".
Data Object "Candidate Response" — written by Intermediate message catch
  event "Candidate response received"; read by Exclusive gateway
  "Candidate accepts offer?".
Data Object "Background Check Request" — written by User task "Initiate
  background check"; read by Send task "Send background check request to
  provider".
Data Object "Background Check Report" — written by Intermediate message
  catch event "Background check result received"; read by Exclusive
  gateway "Background check cleared?", User task "Notify hiring manager
  and review outcome".
Data Object "Confirmed Employment Contract" — written by User task
  "Confirm start date and employment conditions with candidate"; read by
  Send task "Send confirmed contract and onboarding instructions to
  candidate", Service task "Record accepted offer and employee record in
  HRIS / HCM".

Make Offer takes the selected candidate from the assessment stage and
carries them through offer approval, legal review, candidate acceptance,
and pre-employment screening to a fully executed employment contract. It
handles declinations and adverse background-check findings as distinct
terminal or conditional branches. At its close, it hands a cleared,
confirmed employee record to Onboard Employee, together with the signed
contract and agreed start date.
```

### V04.06 — Onboard Employee

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V04.06 Onboard Employee — the subprocess that transitions a
newly hired employee into active employment within the Hire to Retire
value chain.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Employing Organisation" — the organisation running the onboarding
  process, with lanes for Human Resources and Payroll.
  Lanes, top to bottom:
  - Human Resources (onboarding coordinator)
  - Payroll (payroll officer)
Pool "Employee" — the newly hired employee receiving onboarding
  materials and completing required actions.
Pool "Superannuation / Pension Fund" — the external fund receiving
  enrolment and contribution instructions.
Pool "Benefits Provider" — the external provider receiving enrolment
  instructions and confirming coverage.
Pool "HRIS / HCM System" — the system of record for employee master
  data, contracts, and onboarding status.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Employing Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Employee" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Superannuation / Pension Fund" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Benefits Provider" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "HRIS / HCM System" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Employee
2. Employing Organisation
3. Superannuation / Pension Fund
4. Benefits Provider
5. HRIS / HCM System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Employing Organisation)

Human Resources lane:
  Message start event "Accepted offer received from Make Offer"
  Service task "Create employee master record in HRIS / HCM"
  User task "Prepare onboarding pack and contract documentation"
  Send task "Send contract and onboarding instructions to employee"
  Intermediate message catch event "Signed contract received from
    employee"
  User task "Verify signed contract and identity documents"
  Exclusive gateway "Documents complete and verified?"
  - branch "No — documents missing or invalid": Expanded Subprocess
      "Repeat Until Documents Accepted" (standard loop) containing,
      in order: Send task "Request missing or corrected documents from
      employee", Intermediate message catch event "Revised documents
      received from employee", User task "Re-verify documents"
    Exclusive merge gateway "Documents complete and verified?"
  - branch "Yes — documents accepted":
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Documents complete and
      verified?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Documents complete and verified?"
  User task "Record verified documents in HRIS / HCM"
  Send task "Send superannuation / pension enrolment instructions"
  Send task "Send benefits enrolment instructions"
  Intermediate message catch event "Superannuation / pension
    confirmation received"
  Intermediate message catch event "Benefits coverage confirmation
    received"
  User task "Schedule orientation and induction programme"
  Send task "Send orientation schedule to employee"
  User task "Confirm onboarding complete in HRIS / HCM"
  End event "Onboarding complete — ready for Provision Access /
    Equipment"

Payroll lane:
  User task "Capture payroll, tax, and bank details"
  Service task "Record payroll details in HRIS / HCM"
  User task "Set up initial pay run for new employee"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat
  Until Documents Accepted" — label "Document deadline exceeded
  (10 business days)" — triggers End event "Onboarding withdrawn —
  documents not received".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: The flow begins in the Human Resources lane with the
message start event and moves through record creation, pack
preparation, and contract dispatch. After the signed contract is
received, verification is tested at the exclusive gateway "Documents
complete and verified?"; the "No" branch enters the standard-loop
subprocess for document re-request and re-verification, while the
"Yes" branch passes directly to the exclusive merge gateway, from
which both branches rejoin. Control then passes to the Payroll lane
for payroll capture, HRIS recording, and pay-run setup, before
returning to the Human Resources lane for enrolment sends, confirmation
waits, orientation scheduling, and the closing confirmation task.

Message flows:
  Send task "Send contract and onboarding instructions to employee"
    → Employee (employment contract and onboarding instructions)
  Employee → Intermediate message catch event "Signed contract
    received from employee" (signed contract and identity documents)
  Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Documents Accepted" →
    Employee (request for missing or corrected documents)
  Employee → Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Documents Accepted"
    (revised documents)
  User task "Record verified documents in HRIS / HCM" →
    HRIS / HCM System (verified document records)
  Service task "Create employee master record in HRIS / HCM" →
    HRIS / HCM System (new employee master record)
  Service task "Record payroll details in HRIS / HCM" →
    HRIS / HCM System (payroll, tax, and bank details)
  User task "Confirm onboarding complete in HRIS / HCM" →
    HRIS / HCM System (onboarding completion status)
  Send task "Send superannuation / pension enrolment instructions"
    → Superannuation / Pension Fund (enrolment instruction)
  Superannuation / Pension Fund → Intermediate message catch event
    "Superannuation / pension confirmation received"
    (enrolment confirmation)
  Send task "Send benefits enrolment instructions" →
    Benefits Provider (enrolment instruction)
  Benefits Provider → Intermediate message catch event "Benefits
    coverage confirmation received" (coverage confirmation)
  Send task "Send orientation schedule to employee" →
    Employee (orientation and induction schedule)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Employment Contract" — written by User task "Prepare
  onboarding pack and contract documentation"; read by User task
  "Verify signed contract and identity documents".
Data Object "Onboarding Pack" — written by User task "Prepare
  onboarding pack and contract documentation"; read by Send task
  "Send contract and onboarding instructions to employee".
Data Object "Signed Contract and Identity Documents" — read by
  User task "Verify signed contract and identity documents"; read by
  User task "Record verified documents in HRIS / HCM".
Data Object "Payroll and Tax Details" — written by User task
  "Capture payroll, tax, and bank details"; read by Service task
  "Record payroll details in HRIS / HCM".
Data Object "Superannuation / Pension Enrolment Record" — written
  by Send task "Send superannuation / pension enrolment instructions";
  read by Intermediate message catch event "Superannuation / pension
  confirmation received".
Data Object "Benefits Enrolment Record" — written by Send task
  "Send benefits enrolment instructions"; read by Intermediate message
  catch event "Benefits coverage confirmation received".
Data Object "Orientation Schedule" — written by User task "Schedule
  orientation and induction programme"; read by Send task "Send
  orientation schedule to employee".

Onboard Employee takes a newly accepted offer and brings the hire into
active employment by issuing and verifying the employment contract,
capturing payroll and tax details, enrolling the employee with the
superannuation fund and benefits provider, and scheduling their
induction. It closes by confirming onboarding complete in the HRIS /
HCM System, handing a fully recorded new employee to Provision Access
/ Equipment so that system credentials and physical resources can be
assigned.
```

### V04.07 — Provision Access / Equipment

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V04.07 Provision Access / Equipment — the subprocess that sets up
system access and physical equipment for a newly onboarded employee, sitting
between Onboard Employee and Manage Payroll and Benefits in the Hire to
Retire value chain.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Employing Organisation" — the organisation executing the provisioning
process, containing IT and Facilities lanes.
- Lane "IT (IT Provisioning Officer)"
- Lane "Facilities (Facilities Officer)"
Pool "Employee" — the newly onboarded employee receiving access and equipment.
Pool "Identity & Access Management (IAM) System" — system that creates and
manages user accounts and access rights.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Employing Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Employee" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Identity & Access Management (IAM) System" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Employee
2. Employing Organisation
3. Identity & Access Management (IAM) System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Employing Organisation)

IT (IT Provisioning Officer) lane:
  Message start event "Onboarding confirmed — received from Onboard Employee"
  User task "Review provisioning requirements"
  Parallel gateway "Initiate IT and Facilities workstreams"
    - branch "IT provisioning": Service task "Create user account and assign
      roles in IAM system"
      Intermediate message catch event "Account creation confirmed"
      User task "Allocate hardware and peripherals"
      User task "Configure laptop and install software"
      User task "Issue IT equipment to employee"
      (continues to parallel merge gateway "IT and Facilities complete")
    - branch "Facilities provisioning": (continues to Facilities lane)
  Parallel merge gateway "IT and Facilities complete"
  User task "Send access credentials and equipment summary to employee"
  User task "Record provisioning completion in IAM system"
  End event "Access and equipment provisioned — ready for Manage Payroll
  and Benefits"

Facilities (Facilities Officer) lane:
  User task "Prepare workspace and access card"
  User task "Issue building access card and desk assignment to employee"
  (continues to parallel merge gateway "IT and Facilities complete")

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on "Configure laptop and install software"
labelled "Configuration overdue (1 business day)" — triggers User task
"Escalate IT provisioning delay to IT Provisioning Officer manager", which
leads to End event "Provisioning delay escalated".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: Flow begins in the IT lane with the message start event and
moves through the provisioning requirements review to the parallel gateway,
which opens two branches simultaneously. The IT branch runs through account
creation, hardware allocation, configuration, and equipment issue, rejoining
at the parallel merge gateway. The Facilities branch runs through workspace
preparation and access card issuance in the Facilities lane, also rejoining
at the parallel merge gateway. After the merge, flow returns to the IT lane
for credential dispatch and completion recording, ending at the end event.

Message flows:
Service task "Create user account and assign roles in IAM system" →
Identity & Access Management (IAM) System (account creation request with
role assignments).
Identity & Access Management (IAM) System → Intermediate message catch event
"Account creation confirmed" (account creation confirmation).
User task "Record provisioning completion in IAM system" →
Identity & Access Management (IAM) System (provisioning completion record).
User task "Send access credentials and equipment summary to employee" →
Employee (access credentials and equipment summary).
Employee → Message start event "Onboarding confirmed — received from Onboard
Employee" (onboarding confirmation triggering provisioning).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Provisioning Requirements" — written by "Review provisioning
requirements"; read by "Create user account and assign roles in IAM system"
and "Prepare workspace and access card".
Data Object "Equipment Allocation Record" — written by "Allocate hardware and
peripherals"; read by "Issue IT equipment to employee" and "Record provisioning

Data Object "Access Credentials" — written by "Create user account and assign
roles in IAM system"; read by "Send access credentials and equipment summary
to employee".
Data Object "Building Access Card Record" — written by "Issue building access
card and desk assignment to employee"; read by "Record provisioning completion
in IAM system".

This subprocess takes the newly onboarded employee record from Onboard Employee
and ensures the employee has both logical access (user account, system roles,
credentials) and physical access (building card, desk, configured hardware)
before their first day of active employment. It runs the IT and Facilities
workstreams in parallel to minimise lead time. On completion it signals that
the employee is fully equipped, handing a provisioned-employee status to
Manage Payroll and Benefits so that payroll setup can proceed with confidence
that the person is operationally ready.
```

### V04.08 — Manage Payroll and Benefits

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V04.08 Manage Payroll and Benefits — recurring payroll execution and
benefits administration subprocess within the Hire to Retire value chain,
triggered each pay period after employee master data is established in
Onboard Employee and Provision Access / Equipment.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Employing Organisation" — the organisation running payroll and benefits
  administration, with lanes for Payroll and Finance.
Pool "Employee" — the employee who receives payslips and benefits information.
Pool "Superannuation / Pension Fund" — external fund receiving employer and
  employee contributions each pay cycle.
Pool "Benefits Provider" — external provider managing health, insurance, and
  other benefits entitlements.
Pool "Payroll System" — IT system performing payroll calculations, generating
  payslips, and producing payment files.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Employing Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Employee" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Superannuation / Pension Fund" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Benefits Provider" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Payroll System" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Employee
2. Employing Organisation
3. Superannuation / Pension Fund
4. Benefits Provider
5. Payroll System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Employing Organisation)

Payroll lane:
  Timer start event "Pay period opens — recurring payroll cycle begins"
  User task "Collect and verify employee payroll data"
  User task "Apply pay adjustments, allowances, and deductions"
  Service task "Submit payroll data to Payroll System"
  Intermediate message catch event "Payroll calculation results received"
  User task "Review payroll calculation results"
  Exclusive gateway "Payroll results approved?"
  - branch "No — discrepancies found":
      Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Payroll Approved" (standard loop)
      containing, in order: User task "Identify and correct discrepancies",
      User task "Resubmit corrected payroll data to Payroll System",
      Intermediate message catch event "Revised calculation results received",
      User task "Review revised payroll calculation results"
      (exits subprocess)
  - branch "Yes — approved":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Payroll results approved")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Payroll results approved"
  Service task "Authorise payroll for payment run"
  Service task "Transmit superannuation / pension contributions to fund"
  User task "Reconcile payroll against approved payroll register"
  Exclusive gateway "Reconciliation passed?"
  - branch "No — reconciliation variance":
      User task "Investigate and resolve reconciliation variance"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Reconciliation passed")
  - branch "Yes — reconciliation clear":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Reconciliation passed")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Reconciliation passed"
  User task "Update benefits enrolments and deductions"
  Service task "Transmit benefits deductions and enrolment data to Benefits
  Provider"
  Intermediate message catch event "Benefits confirmation received"
  User task "Record benefits confirmation in Payroll System"
  End event "Payroll and benefits cycle complete — ready for Manage Changes"

Finance lane:
  User task "Review and approve payroll expenditure against budget"
  User task "Post payroll journal entries to general ledger"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Payroll
Approved" — labelled "Correction deadline exceeded (2 business days)" —
triggers End event "Payroll cycle escalated — finance controller notified".

Interrupting timer boundary event on Intermediate message catch event
"Benefits confirmation received" — labelled "Benefits confirmation not
received within 3 business days" — triggers User task "Chase Benefits
Provider for confirmation" in Payroll lane, rejoining the flow at User task
"Record benefits confirmation in Payroll System".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: The flow begins in the Payroll lane with the timer start
event, proceeds through data collection and adjustment tasks, moves to the
Payroll System via a service task, returns via a message catch event, passes
through the approval gateway — looping via the correction subprocess until
approved, then merging — proceeds to authorisation and contribution
transmission, crosses into the Finance lane for expenditure review, approval,
and journal posting before returning to Payroll for reconciliation,
benefits update, Benefits Provider transmission, confirmation catch, and
recording, closing at the end event.

Message flows:
Employee → User task "Collect and verify employee payroll data" (tax file
  details, bank account, salary and allowance declarations)
Service task "Submit payroll data to Payroll System" → Payroll System
  (payroll run request with employee pay data)
Payroll System → Intermediate message catch event "Payroll calculation
  results received" (gross pay, tax, net pay calculations, deduction
  schedules)
Service task "Authorise payroll for payment run" → Payroll System
  (payment authorisation instruction)
Payroll System → Employee (payslip issued for the pay period)
Service task "Transmit superannuation / pension contributions to fund" →
  Superannuation / Pension Fund (employer and employee contribution file)
Superannuation / Pension Fund → Payroll lane (contribution receipt
  acknowledgement)
Service task "Transmit benefits deductions and enrolment data to Benefits
  Provider" → Benefits Provider (deduction amounts and enrolment changes)
Benefits Provider → Intermediate message catch event "Benefits confirmation
  received" (benefits processing confirmation)
Service task "Record benefits confirmation in Payroll System" → Payroll
  System (benefits confirmation update)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Payroll Register" — written by User task "Apply pay
  adjustments, allowances, and deductions"; read by User task "Review
  payroll calculation results"; read by User task "Reconcile payroll against
  approved payroll register".
Data Object "Payslip" — written by Payroll System (via authorised payment
  run); read by Employee (delivered as message flow).
Data Object "Superannuation Contribution File" — written by Service task
  "Transmit superannuation / pension contributions to fund"; read by
  Superannuation / Pension Fund.
Data Object "Benefits Enrolment and Deduction Schedule" — written by User
  task "Update benefits enrolments and deductions"; read by Service task
  "Transmit benefits deductions and enrolment data to Benefits Provider".
Data Object "Payroll Journal" — written by User task "Post payroll journal
  entries to general ledger"; read by User task "Reconcile payroll against
  approved payroll register".

Manage Payroll and Benefits executes the recurring pay cycle for all active
employees: it collects and validates pay data, obtains a Payroll System
calculation, secures Finance approval, issues payslips, remits superannuation
contributions, and confirms benefits deductions with the Benefits Provider.
Every cycle closes with a reconciled payroll journal, giving Manage Changes
a verified financial baseline against which any subsequent employment changes
— salary adjustments, role transfers, or entitlement updates — can be
accurately applied.
```
