### V24.01 — Capture Transactions with Tax Attributes

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.01 Capture Transactions with Tax Attributes — first subprocess
of the Transaction to Return value chain, capturing transactional data
with tax attributes from customers and suppliers into the ERP and
general ledger.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the internal teams that capture and validate
  transactions with tax attributes, comprising Finance / Accounting
  (financial accountant).
Pool "Customer" — external party supplying tax invoices and exemption
  certificates for sale-side transactions.
Pool "Supplier" — external party supplying tax invoices and exemption
  certificates for purchase-side transactions.
Pool "ERP / General Ledger" — IT system that records transactions,
  stores tax codes, and provides ledger data.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Customer" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Supplier" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "ERP / General Ledger" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Customer
2. Supplier
3. Organisation
4. ERP / General Ledger

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Finance / Accounting lane:
  Message start event "Tax invoice or exemption certificate received
    from Customer or Supplier"
  User task "Log incoming invoice or certificate"
  User task "Classify transaction type (sale, purchase, import, payroll,
    other)"
  Service task "Retrieve applicable tax codes from ERP"
  Exclusive gateway "Document complete and tax attributes identifiable?"
    - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Document
      complete and tax attributes identifiable?")
    - branch "No": User task "Request missing information or corrected
      document"
      Intermediate message catch event "Corrected document or
        information received"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Document complete and tax
        attributes identifiable?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Document complete and tax attributes
    identifiable?"
  User task "Assign tax codes and attributes to transaction"
  Service task "Post transaction with tax attributes to ERP / General
    Ledger"
  Exclusive gateway "Transaction posted without errors?"
    - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Transaction
      posted without errors?")
    - branch "No": User task "Investigate and correct posting error"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Transaction posted without
        errors?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Transaction posted without errors?"
  User task "Retain supporting document in line with record-retention
    policy"
  End event "Transaction with tax attributes captured — ready for
    Determine Tax Treatment"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on "Request missing information or
  corrected document" — label "Follow-up deadline elapsed" — triggers
  User task "Escalate missing document to tax manager" which leads to
  End event "Transaction capture escalated — pending supplier or
  customer response".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: work begins in the Finance / Accounting lane with the
  message start event and proceeds linearly through logging,
  classification, and code retrieval. The first exclusive gateway
  branches to a corrected-document request path (with an intermediate
  message catch event) and a straight-through path, both rejoining at
  the first exclusive merge gateway. Flow continues through attribute
  assignment and ERP posting. The second exclusive gateway branches to
  an error-correction path and a straight-through path, both rejoining
  at the second exclusive merge gateway, after which document retention
  leads to the end event.

Message flows:
  Customer → Organisation / Finance / Accounting (tax invoice or
    exemption certificate)
  Supplier → Organisation / Finance / Accounting (tax invoice or
    exemption certificate)
  Organisation / Finance / Accounting → Customer (request for missing
    information or corrected document)
  Organisation / Finance / Accounting → Supplier (request for missing
    information or corrected document)
  Customer → Organisation / Finance / Accounting (corrected document or
    information — received at intermediate message catch event)
  Supplier → Organisation / Finance / Accounting (corrected document or
    information — received at intermediate message catch event)
  ERP / General Ledger → Organisation / Finance / Accounting
    (applicable tax codes returned by "Retrieve applicable tax codes
    from ERP")
  Organisation / Finance / Accounting → ERP / General Ledger
    (transaction with tax attributes posted by "Post transaction with
    tax attributes to ERP / General Ledger")

7. Data objects

Data Object "Tax Invoice / Exemption Certificate" — read by "Log
  incoming invoice or certificate"; read by "Assign tax codes and
  attributes to transaction".
Data Object "Transaction Record with Tax Attributes" — written by
  "Assign tax codes and attributes to transaction"; read by "Post
  transaction with tax attributes to ERP / General Ledger".
Data Object "Tax Code Table" — read by "Retrieve applicable tax codes
  from ERP"; read by "Assign tax codes and attributes to transaction".

This subprocess captures every inbound tax invoice and exemption
certificate from customers and suppliers, classifies each transaction,
assigns the correct tax codes and attributes, and posts the validated
record to the ERP / General Ledger. It hands a complete set of
coded transactional data to Determine Tax Treatment, which will apply
jurisdiction-specific rules to confirm the precise tax treatment for
each transaction.
```


### V24.02 — Determine Tax Treatment

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.02 Determine Tax Treatment — second subprocess in the
Transaction to Return value chain, receiving coded transactions from
Capture Transactions with Tax Attributes and producing confirmed tax
treatment ready for Calculate Liabilities & Credits.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the organisation's teams performing tax treatment
determination.
  Lane "Tax" — indirect tax analyst reviewing and confirming tax
  treatment for each transaction or transaction class.

Pool "Tax Determination Engine" — system that holds jurisdiction and
product rate tables, applies determination rules, and returns treatment
results.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Tax Determination Engine" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Organisation (white-box, single lane)
2. Tax Determination Engine (black-box, below)

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Tax lane:
  Message start event "Tax-attributed transactions received from
    Capture Transactions with Tax Attributes"
  User task "Review transaction records for tax relevance"
  Exclusive gateway "Transaction type recognised?"
    - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Transaction type recognised")
    - branch "No — novel or uncertain treatment":
      User task "Research applicable legislation and rulings"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Transaction type recognised")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Transaction type recognised"
  Service task "Submit transaction attributes to determination engine"
  Intermediate message catch event "Determination result received"
  User task "Review determination result against policy and
    jurisdiction rules"
  Exclusive gateway "Treatment determination correct?"
    - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Treatment determination correct")
    - branch "No — override required":
      User task "Document override rationale and apply manual
        treatment"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Treatment determination correct")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Treatment determination correct"
  Exclusive gateway "Uncertain tax position identified?"
    - branch "Yes":
      User task "Flag and document uncertain tax position"
      User task "Escalate uncertain position to tax manager"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Uncertain tax position identified")
    - branch "No": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Uncertain tax position identified")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Uncertain tax position identified"
  User task "Confirm and record final tax treatment on transaction"
  End event "Tax treatment confirmed — ready for Calculate
    Liabilities & Credits"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

None.

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: all flow within the Tax lane. Transactions arrive at
the message start event and proceed through the recognition gateway; the
"No" branch passes through the legislation research task before joining
the merge gateway. After submission to the determination engine, a
message catch event pauses the flow until a result is returned. The
policy review gateway branches to a manual override task on "No" before
rejoining. The uncertain-position gateway sends the "Yes" branch through
flagging and escalation tasks before the merge, then the flow advances
to the final confirmation task and the end event.

Message flows:
Tax Determination Engine → Tax lane, "Submit transaction attributes to
  determination engine" task (transaction attribute query sent)
Tax Determination Engine → Tax lane, intermediate message catch event
  "Determination result received" (treatment result and applied rule
  returned)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Transaction Records with Tax Attributes" — read by
  "Review transaction records for tax relevance".
Data Object "Applicable Legislation and Rulings" — written by
  "Research applicable legislation and rulings"; read by "Document
  override rationale and apply manual treatment".
Data Object "Determination Result" — read by "Review determination
  result against policy and jurisdiction rules".
Data Object "Override Rationale" — written by "Document override
  rationale and apply manual treatment"; read by "Confirm and record
  final tax treatment on transaction".
Data Object "Uncertain Tax Position Record" — written by "Flag and
  document uncertain tax position"; read by "Escalate uncertain position
  to tax manager".
Data Object "Confirmed Tax Treatment" — written by "Confirm and record
  final tax treatment on transaction".

This subprocess takes tax-attributed transactions produced by Capture
Transactions with Tax Attributes, validates each against jurisdiction
and product determination rules held in the Tax Determination Engine,
and resolves any novel, overridden, or uncertain positions through
research and escalation. It hands a confirmed tax treatment record for
every transaction to Calculate Liabilities & Credits, where those
treatments become the basis for computing the organisation's tax
liabilities and recoverable credits.
```


### V24.03 — Calculate Liabilities & Credits

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.03 Calculate Liabilities & Credits — third subprocess in the
Transaction to Return value chain, converting coded transactions into
computed tax liabilities and credits ready for account reconciliation.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the entity performing tax calculations, with lanes
for the Tax team and Finance/Accounting team.
Pool "Tax Determination Engine" — the calculation and rate-rules system
that computes liability and credit amounts.
Pool "ERP / General Ledger" — the system of record for financial
transactions and period balances.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Tax Determination Engine" — black-box, System = true, single
instance.
Pool "ERP / General Ledger" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Organisation (white-box, with lanes Tax then Finance / Accounting)
2. Tax Determination Engine
3. ERP / General Ledger

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Tax lane:
  Message start event "Tax-coded transaction data received from
    Capture Transactions with Tax Attributes"
  User task "Review coded transaction data for completeness"
  Exclusive gateway "Data complete and sufficient?"
  - branch "No — gaps or errors found":
      Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Data Complete" (standard loop)
        containing, in order: User task "Identify missing or
        incorrect tax attributes", Send task "Request correction
        from Finance / Accounting"
      Intermediate message catch event "Corrected data received"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Data complete and
        sufficient?")
  - branch "Yes — data accepted":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Data complete and
        sufficient?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Data complete and sufficient?"
  Service task "Extract transaction data by tax type and jurisdiction"
  Send task "Submit transaction data to Tax Determination Engine
    for liability calculation"
  Intermediate message catch event "Calculated liability and credit
    results received"
  User task "Review calculated liabilities and credits by tax type"
  Exclusive gateway "Calculation results acceptable?"
  - branch "No — discrepancies identified":
      User task "Investigate discrepancy in calculation results"
      Send task "Send corrected inputs to Tax Determination Engine"
      Intermediate message catch event "Revised calculation results
        received"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Calculation results
        acceptable?")
  - branch "Yes — results accepted":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Calculation results
        acceptable?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Calculation results acceptable?"
  User task "Classify liabilities and credits by period and
    jurisdiction"
  User task "Identify and document uncertain tax positions"
  Exclusive gateway "Uncertain tax positions present?"
  - branch "Yes — escalation required":
      User task "Escalate uncertain positions for tax manager
        review"
      User task "Record treatment decision and supporting rationale"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Uncertain tax positions
        present?")
  - branch "No — no escalation needed":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Uncertain tax positions
        present?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Uncertain tax positions present?"
  Send task "Send final liability and credit totals to ERP /
    General Ledger for posting"
  Intermediate message catch event "Posting confirmation received
    from ERP / General Ledger"

Finance / Accounting lane:
  User task "Post confirmed liabilities and credits to general
    ledger accounts"
  User task "Produce period liability and credit summary report"
  End event "Liabilities and credits posted — ready for
    Reconcile Tax Accounts"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
Data Complete" — label "Correction overdue (2 business days)" —
triggers End event "Data correction deadline exceeded — escalate to
tax manager".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: work begins in the Tax lane with the message start
event, passes through the data-completeness gateway (with the standard-
loop subprocess handling the correction cycle before rejoining the
merge), then flows through extraction, submission to the Tax
Determination Engine, review, and the acceptability gateway (whose
discrepancy branch sends corrected inputs and awaits revised results
before rejoining the merge), then through classification, uncertain-
position handling (with the escalation branch rejoining the merge),
and finally the ledger posting send task and confirmation event,
crossing into the Finance / Accounting lane for posting, report
production, and the end event.

Message flows:
Organisation (Tax lane — Send task "Submit transaction data to Tax
  Determination Engine for liability calculation") →
  Tax Determination Engine (transaction data by tax type and
  jurisdiction)
Tax Determination Engine → Organisation (Tax lane — Intermediate
  message catch event "Calculated liability and credit results
  received") (computed liability and credit amounts)
Organisation (Tax lane — Send task "Send corrected inputs to Tax
  Determination Engine") → Tax Determination Engine (corrected
  calculation inputs)
Tax Determination Engine → Organisation (Tax lane — Intermediate
  message catch event "Revised calculation results received")
  (revised liability and credit amounts)
Organisation (Tax lane — Send task "Send final liability and credit
  totals to ERP / General Ledger for posting") →
  ERP / General Ledger (final liability and credit totals)
ERP / General Ledger → Organisation (Tax lane — Intermediate message
  catch event "Posting confirmation received from ERP / General
  Ledger") (posting confirmation and journal reference)
ERP / General Ledger → Organisation (Tax lane — Message start event)
  (tax-coded transaction data from prior subprocess)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Coded Transaction Dataset" — read by User task "Review
  coded transaction data for completeness"; written by Service task
  "Extract transaction data by tax type and jurisdiction".
Data Object "Liability and Credit Calculation Results" — written by
  Intermediate message catch event "Calculated liability and credit
  results received"; read by User task "Review calculated liabilities
  and credits by tax type".
Data Object "Uncertain Tax Position Record" — written by User task
  "Identify and document uncertain tax positions"; read by User task
  "Escalate uncertain positions for tax manager review" and User task
  "Record treatment decision and supporting rationale".
Data Object "Period Liability and Credit Summary" — written by User
  task "Produce period liability and credit summary report"; read by
  User task "Post confirmed liabilities and credits to general ledger
  accounts".

V24.03 takes tax-coded transaction data from the capture subprocess,
submits it to the Tax Determination Engine to compute gross liabilities
and available credits by tax type and jurisdiction, resolves any
discrepancies, escalates uncertain positions for documented treatment
decisions, and posts confirmed totals to the general ledger. It hands
a posted, period-dated liability and credit summary to V24.04
Reconcile Tax Accounts.
```


### V24.04 — Reconcile Tax Accounts

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.04 Reconcile Tax Accounts — sits within the Transaction to
Return value chain, reconciling tax account balances to the general ledger
after liabilities and credits have been calculated.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the internal teams performing the reconciliation.
  Lane "Finance / Accounting" — financial accountant who runs ledger
    extracts and investigates variances.
  Lane "Tax" — tax accountant who validates reconciled balances and
    escalates unresolved items.

Pool "ERP / General Ledger" — enterprise resource planning and general
  ledger system holding transaction detail and account balances.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "ERP / General Ledger" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Organisation (white-box; Finance / Accounting lane above Tax lane)
2. ERP / General Ledger

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Finance / Accounting lane:
  Message start event "Calculated liabilities and credits received from
    Calculate Liabilities & Credits"
  Service task "Extract tax account balances from ERP"
  Service task "Extract general ledger trial balance"
  User task "Compare tax account balances to general ledger"
  Exclusive gateway "Variances identified?"
  - branch "No variances": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Variances resolved?")
  - branch "Variances identified": User task "Investigate variance items"
      Exclusive gateway "Variance explained?"
      - branch "Explained — correcting entry needed": User task
          "Post correcting journal entry to ERP"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Variance explained?")
      - branch "Cannot be explained": User task "Escalate unresolved
          variance to Tax accountant"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Variance explained?")
      Exclusive merge gateway "Variance explained?"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Variances resolved?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Variances resolved?"
  User task "Prepare reconciliation summary"
  End event "Reconciliation complete — ready for Prepare Return &
    Workpapers"

Tax lane:
  User task "Review escalated variance and determine treatment"
  Exclusive gateway "Variance resolvable?"
  - branch "Yes — resolution agreed": User task "Advise Finance of
      correcting action"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Variance resolvable?")
  - branch "No — uncertain tax position": User task "Flag uncertain tax
      position for return preparation"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Variance resolvable?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Variance resolvable?"
  User task "Validate final reconciled balances"
  (continues to Finance / Accounting lane exclusive merge gateway
    "Variances resolved?")

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on User task "Investigate variance
  items" — label "Investigation deadline exceeded" — triggers User task
  "Escalate unresolved variance to Tax accountant" in Finance /
  Accounting lane.

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: flow begins in the Finance / Accounting lane at the
message start event, passes through ledger extraction and comparison
tasks, then branches at "Variances identified?" — the no-variance branch
proceeds directly to the merge; the variance branch passes through
investigation and, where unresolved, crosses to the Tax lane for review
and validation before returning to the Finance / Accounting lane to
merge at "Variances resolved?" and close at the reconciliation summary
and end event.

Message flows:
ERP / General Ledger → Service task "Extract tax account balances from
  ERP" (tax account balance data).
ERP / General Ledger → Service task "Extract general ledger trial
  balance" (trial balance figures).
User task "Post correcting journal entry to ERP" → ERP / General Ledger
  (correcting journal entry).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Tax Account Balance Extract" — written by Service task
  "Extract tax account balances from ERP"; read by User task "Compare
  tax account balances to general ledger".
Data Object "General Ledger Trial Balance" — written by Service task
  "Extract general ledger trial balance"; read by User task "Compare
  tax account balances to general ledger".
Data Object "Variance Analysis" — written by User task "Compare tax
  account balances to general ledger"; read by User task "Investigate
  variance items" and User task "Review escalated variance and determine
  treatment".
Data Object "Reconciliation Summary" — written by User task "Prepare
  reconciliation summary"; read by the end event and carried forward to
  Prepare Return & Workpapers.

This subprocess takes the calculated tax liabilities and credits from
V24.03 and reconciles every tax account to the general ledger, resolving
or escalating variances and posting correcting journals where needed.
The output — a signed-off reconciliation summary with validated balances
— is handed to V24.05 Prepare Return & Workpapers as the authoritative
source of figures for the return.
```


### V24.05 — Prepare Return & Workpapers

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.05 Prepare Return & Workpapers — fifth subprocess in the
Transaction to Return value chain, receiving reconciled tax account data
from Reconcile Tax Accounts and handing an approved draft return package
to Review & Approve.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the internal teams preparing the return and
workpapers, with lanes for Tax and (via external adviser) supported
preparation work.
  Lane "Tax" — tax accountant performing return preparation and
  workpaper assembly.
Pool "External Tax Adviser" — external adviser engaged to review
workpapers and provide opinions.
Pool "Tax Reporting System" — system used to draft and store the
return.
Pool "Document Management System" — system used to store and
retrieve workpapers and supporting documentation.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "External Tax Adviser" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Tax Reporting System" — black-box, System = true, single instance.
Pool "Document Management System" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

External Tax Adviser — top.
Organisation (Tax lane) — middle.
Tax Reporting System — below Organisation.
Document Management System — bottom.

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Tax lane:
  Message start event "Reconciled tax account data received from
  Reconcile Tax Accounts"
  Service task "Retrieve reconciled balances and transaction detail"
  User task "Identify return periods, jurisdictions and applicable forms"
  Service task "Load trial balance and tax data into Tax Reporting System"
  User task "Draft return schedules and supporting calculations"
  Service task "Save draft return to Tax Reporting System"
  User task "Assemble workpapers and source documents"
  Service task "Upload workpapers to Document Management System"
  Exclusive gateway "External adviser review required?"
    - branch "Yes": Send task "Send workpapers and data to External Tax
      Adviser"
      Intermediate message catch event "Adviser opinion received"
      User task "Incorporate adviser comments into workpapers"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "External adviser review
      required?")
    - branch "No": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "External
      adviser review required?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "External adviser review required?"
  User task "Perform internal completeness check on return package"
  Exclusive gateway "Return package complete?"
    - branch "No": Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Package Complete"
      (standard loop) containing, in order: User task "Identify and
      resolve gaps or errors", User task "Update return schedules and
      workpapers", Service task "Save updated draft to Tax Reporting
      System", Service task "Upload revised workpapers to Document
      Management System"
    - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Return
      package complete?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Return package complete?"
  User task "Compile final return package for review"
  End event "Return package and workpapers complete — ready for
  Review & Approve"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
Package Complete" — label "Lodgement deadline reached" — triggers End
event "Package incomplete at deadline — escalate to tax manager".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: the single Tax lane carries all flow from the message
start event forward through retrieval, drafting, workpaper assembly,
the adviser-review gateway (whose Yes branch sends to the adviser and
waits for the opinion before rejoining the merge), the completeness
check gateway (whose No branch enters the standard-loop subprocess and
whose Yes branch bypasses it), both branches rejoining at the merge
gateway, and ending at the final end event. The timer boundary on the
loop subprocess exits to a separate escalation end event.

Message flows:
External Tax Adviser → Tax lane (adviser opinion) — Intermediate
message catch event "Adviser opinion received".
Tax lane → External Tax Adviser (workpapers and supporting data) —
Send task "Send workpapers and data to External Tax Adviser".
Tax lane → Tax Reporting System (draft return and updated schedules) —
Service tasks "Save draft return to Tax Reporting System" and "Save
updated draft to Tax Reporting System".
Tax Reporting System → Tax lane (loaded tax data and prior-period
comparatives) — Service task "Load trial balance and tax data into
Tax Reporting System".
Tax lane → Document Management System (workpapers and source
documents) — Service tasks "Upload workpapers to Document Management
System" and "Upload revised workpapers to Document Management System".
Document Management System → Tax lane (retrieved supporting
documentation) — Service task "Retrieve reconciled balances and
transaction detail".

7. Data objects

Data Object "Reconciled Tax Account Data" — read by "Retrieve
reconciled balances and transaction detail".
Data Object "Draft Return Schedules" — written by "Draft return
schedules and supporting calculations"; read by "Perform internal
completeness check on return package".
Data Object "Workpaper Package" — written by "Assemble workpapers and
source documents"; read by "Send workpapers and data to External Tax
Adviser" and "Compile final return package for review".
Data Object "Adviser Opinion" — written by "Incorporate adviser
comments into workpapers"; read by "Perform internal completeness
check on return package".
Data Object "Final Return Package" — written by "Compile final return
package for review"; read by End event "Return package and workpapers
complete — ready for Review & Approve".

This subprocess takes the reconciled tax account data produced by
Reconcile Tax Accounts and transforms it into a complete, documented
return package ready for formal review. The tax accountant drafts return
schedules, assembles workpapers, engages the external adviser where
needed, and iterates until the package is internally verified as
complete. The finished return package and workpapers are then handed to
Review & Approve for sign-off by the tax manager.
```


### V24.06 — Review & Approve

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.06 Review & Approve — the tax manager reviews draft returns
and workpapers produced in Prepare Return & Workpapers and either approves
them for lodgement or returns them for correction.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the internal teams performing the review and approval
  Lane "Tax" — tax manager leads the review, approval and rework
  co-ordination
Pool "Tax Reporting System" — system holding draft returns and workpapers
  for review and recording of approval status

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance
Pool "Tax Reporting System" — black-box, System = true, single instance

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Organisation (white-box, holds process flow)
2. Tax Reporting System (black-box, IT system)

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Tax lane:
  Message start event "Approved draft return and workpapers received from
    Prepare Return & Workpapers"
  Service task "Retrieve draft return and workpapers from Tax Reporting
    System"
  User task "Review return for completeness and accuracy"
  Exclusive gateway "Review outcome?"
  - branch "Issues identified — correction required":
      User task "Document review findings and required corrections"
      Send task "Return draft to Tax lane for rework"
      Intermediate message catch event "Revised draft received"
      Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Review Satisfied" (standard loop)
        containing, in order: User task "Re-review revised return and
        workpapers", Exclusive gateway "Further issues?",
        - branch "Yes — further corrections needed": User task "Document
          further findings", Send task "Return revised draft for
          rework", Intermediate message catch event "Next revised draft
          received" (loop repeats)
        - branch "No — review satisfied": (exits subprocess)
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Review outcome")
  - branch "No issues — return acceptable":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Review outcome")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Review outcome"
  User task "Apply formal approval to return in Tax Reporting System"
  Service task "Record approval status and approver details in Tax
    Reporting System"
  User task "Confirm lodgement authorisation and sign off"
  End event "Return approved — ready for Lodge Return"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
  Review Satisfied" — label "Review deadline exceeded" — triggers
  End event "Escalation raised — approval not completed within deadline".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: all flow within the Tax lane from the message start event
  through the retrieval task, the review task, and into the exclusive
  gateway "Review outcome?". The correction branch passes through document
  findings, the send task, the intermediate catch event, and the loop
  subprocess before rejoining at the exclusive merge gateway "Review
  outcome". The no-issues branch rejoins the same merge gateway directly.
  From the merge gateway flow continues to the approval task, the recording
  service task, the sign-off task, and the end event. The timer boundary
  event on the loop subprocess exits to a separate escalation end event
  without rejoining the main flow.

Message flows:
  Tax Reporting System → Organisation / Tax lane, Service task "Retrieve
    draft return and workpapers from Tax Reporting System" (draft return
    and workpapers)
  Organisation / Tax lane, Service task "Record approval status and
    approver details in Tax Reporting System" → Tax Reporting System
    (approval status and approver record)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Draft Tax Return" — read by "Review return for completeness
  and accuracy"; read by "Re-review revised return and workpapers".
Data Object "Review Findings" — written by "Document review findings and
  required corrections"; written by "Document further findings"; read by
  "Return draft to Tax lane for rework".
Data Object "Approval Record" — written by "Apply formal approval to return
  in Tax Reporting System"; read by "Confirm lodgement authorisation and
  sign off".

V24.06 Review & Approve takes the draft return and workpapers produced in
Prepare Return & Workpapers and subjects them to structured review by the
tax manager, cycling through correction rounds until the return meets
quality and compliance standards. Formal approval is recorded in the Tax
Reporting System together with authorised-signatory details. The approved
and signed-off return is then handed to Lodge Return, where it will be
transmitted to the Tax Authority.
```


### V24.07 — Lodge Return

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.07 Lodge Return — the subprocess in which the Tax team
formally submits the approved tax return to the Tax Authority via the
E-Filing Gateway, obtains a lodgement confirmation, and hands off to
Pay or Claim Balance.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the entity lodging the return, with lanes for
the teams involved.
  Lane "Tax" — tax manager who authorises and oversees the lodgement.
Pool "Tax Authority" — the revenue office that receives the return and
issues confirmation.
Pool "E-Filing Gateway" — the electronic submission platform used to
transmit the return to the authority.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Tax Authority" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "E-Filing Gateway" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Tax Authority
2. Organisation (Lane: Tax)
3. E-Filing Gateway

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Tax lane:
Message start event "Approved return received from Review & Approve"
User task "Confirm lodgement readiness and sign-off"
User task "Prepare return package for submission"
Service task "Transmit return to E-Filing Gateway"
Intermediate message catch event "Lodgement acknowledgement received"
Exclusive gateway "Submission accepted?"
  - branch "Yes — accepted": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
    "Submission accepted")
  - branch "No — rejected or error": User task "Review rejection
    reason and correct return"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Submission accepted")
Exclusive merge gateway "Submission accepted"
Service task "Retrieve and store lodgement confirmation"
User task "Record lodgement in compliance calendar"
End event "Return lodged — ready for Pay or Claim Balance"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Service task "Transmit return to
E-Filing Gateway" — label "Submission deadline elapsed" — triggers
User task "Escalate overdue submission to tax manager", which leads to
an End event "Submission deadline breach — escalated".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: Work begins in the Tax lane at the message start event
and proceeds linearly through confirmation of readiness, package
preparation, and transmission. After transmission the flow waits at
the intermediate message catch event for an acknowledgement, then
reaches the exclusive gateway "Submission accepted?". The "Yes"
branch and the corrected "No" branch both converge at the exclusive
merge gateway "Submission accepted", after which the flow continues
to retrieve and store the confirmation, record the lodgement, and
close at the end event.

Message flows:
Service task "Transmit return to E-Filing Gateway" → Pool "E-Filing
Gateway" (return package submitted for transmission).
Pool "E-Filing Gateway" → Intermediate message catch event
"Lodgement acknowledgement received" (submission status and
acknowledgement code).
Pool "E-Filing Gateway" → Pool "Tax Authority" (return data forwarded
to revenue authority).
Pool "Tax Authority" → Pool "E-Filing Gateway" (acceptance or
rejection decision and confirmation receipt).
Service task "Retrieve and store lodgement confirmation" → Pool
"E-Filing Gateway" (request for confirmation document).
Pool "E-Filing Gateway" → Service task "Retrieve and store lodgement
confirmation" (lodgement confirmation receipt).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Approved Return Package" — read by User task "Confirm
lodgement readiness and sign-off"; read by User task "Prepare return
package for submission".
Data Object "Submission Package" — written by User task "Prepare
return package for submission"; read by Service task "Transmit return
to E-Filing Gateway".
Data Object "Lodgement Confirmation Receipt" — written by Service task
"Retrieve and store lodgement confirmation"; read by User task "Record
lodgement in compliance calendar".
Data Object "Rejection Notice" — written by intermediate message catch
event "Lodgement acknowledgement received"; read by User task "Review
rejection reason and correct return".

V24.07 Lodge Return takes the approved, signed-off return from V24.06
and formally transmits it to the Tax Authority through the E-Filing
Gateway, handling any rejections through a correction loop and
capturing the official confirmation receipt. On successful acceptance
it records the event in the compliance calendar and passes the
confirmed lodgement details to V24.08 Pay or Claim Balance, which
will use them to settle or recover the outstanding tax position.
```


### V24.08 — Pay or Claim Balance

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.08 Pay or Claim Balance — the subprocess in which Treasury
settles the net tax balance with the Tax Authority, either remitting
a payment or lodging a refund claim, following return lodgement.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the entity settling its tax balance, with
  Treasury (treasury analyst) as the operating lane.
Pool "Tax Authority" — the revenue office receiving payment or
  processing a refund claim.
Pool "Treasury & Payment System" — the system that processes and
  records payments and receipts.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Tax Authority" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Treasury & Payment System" — black-box, System = true,
  single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Tax Authority
2. Organisation
3. Treasury & Payment System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Treasury lane:
  Message start event "Lodged return received from Lodge Return"
  User task "Review net tax position from lodged return"
  Exclusive gateway "Balance position?"
  - branch "balance payable":
      User task "Prepare payment instruction"
      Service task "Submit payment to Treasury and Payment System"
      Intermediate message catch event "Payment confirmation received"
      Send task "Remit payment to Tax Authority"
      Intermediate message catch event "Tax Authority payment
        receipt received"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Balance position")
  - branch "balance refundable":
      User task "Prepare refund claim"
      Send task "Lodge refund claim with Tax Authority"
      Intermediate message catch event "Tax Authority refund
        decision received"
      Exclusive gateway "Refund decision?"
      - branch "refund approved":
          Intermediate message catch event "Refund payment
            received from Tax Authority"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Refund decision")
      - branch "refund disputed or further information required":
          User task "Prepare and submit supporting documentation"
          Service task "Upload supporting documentation to
            Document Management System"
          Intermediate message catch event "Revised decision
            received from Tax Authority"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Refund decision")
      Exclusive merge gateway "Refund decision"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Balance position")
  - branch "balance nil":
      User task "Record nil balance confirmation"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Balance position")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Balance position"
  Service task "Record settlement outcome in Treasury and
    Payment System"
  User task "Update tax accounts with settlement details"
  End event "Balance settled — ready for Respond to Queries
    and Audits"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on User task "Prepare payment
  instruction" — label "Payment due date reached" — triggers
  Send task "Send urgent payment instruction to treasury analyst"
  leading to an End event "Payment deadline escalation raised".
Interrupting timer boundary event on Intermediate message catch
  event "Tax Authority refund decision received" — label
  "Refund response overdue" — triggers User task "Follow up
  refund status with Tax Authority" leading back to the same
  intermediate catch event (modelled as a standard-loop
  subprocess boundary).

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: work begins in the Treasury lane on receipt of
  the lodged-return message and flows through the balance-position
  gateway into three branches — payable, refundable, and nil —
  each rejoining at the exclusive merge gateway "Balance position"
  before the settlement recording steps and the end event. Within
  the refundable branch a nested exclusive gateway "Refund
  decision" splits into approved and disputed branches, both
  rejoining at the exclusive merge gateway "Refund decision"
  before continuing to the outer merge.

Message flows:
  Organisation (Send task "Remit payment to Tax Authority") →
    Tax Authority (payment remittance).
  Tax Authority → Organisation (Intermediate message catch event
    "Tax Authority payment receipt received") (payment receipt).
  Organisation (Send task "Lodge refund claim with Tax Authority")
    → Tax Authority (refund claim submission).
  Tax Authority → Organisation (Intermediate message catch event
    "Tax Authority refund decision received") (refund decision).
  Tax Authority → Organisation (Intermediate message catch event
    "Refund payment received from Tax Authority") (refund funds).
  Organisation (Service task "Submit payment to Treasury and
    Payment System") → Treasury & Payment System (payment
    instruction).
  Treasury & Payment System → Organisation (Intermediate message
    catch event "Payment confirmation received") (payment
    confirmation).
  Organisation (Service task "Record settlement outcome in
    Treasury and Payment System") → Treasury & Payment System
    (settlement record update).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Net Tax Position" — read by User task "Review net
  tax position from lodged return".
Data Object "Payment Instruction" — written by User task
  "Prepare payment instruction"; read by Service task "Submit
  payment to Treasury and Payment System".
Data Object "Refund Claim" — written by User task "Prepare
  refund claim"; read by Send task "Lodge refund claim with
  Tax Authority".
Data Object "Supporting Documentation" — written by User task
  "Prepare and submit supporting documentation"; read by
  Service task "Upload supporting documentation to Document
  Management System".
Data Object "Settlement Record" — written by Service task
  "Record settlement outcome in Treasury and Payment System";
  read by User task "Update tax accounts with settlement
  details".

V24.08 Pay or Claim Balance resolves the net tax position that
emerges from the lodged return by either remitting payment to the
Tax Authority or pursuing a refund claim through to receipt of
funds, with all outcomes recorded in the Treasury & Payment
System and tax accounts updated accordingly. The subprocess hands
a fully settled or formally confirmed balance position to
V24.09 Respond to Queries & Audits, where any subsequent
authority enquiries or audit activity arising from the return
and payment can be managed.
```


### V24.09 — Respond to Queries & Audits

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V24.09 Respond to Queries & Audits — subprocess in the Transaction to
Return value chain in which the organisation receives, analyses, and responds
to queries and audit findings from the Tax Authority, supported by External
Tax Advisers and Legal, handing any agreed outcomes to Pay or Claim Balance.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Organisation" — the entity managing tax query and audit responses,
  with lanes for Tax and Legal.
Pool "Tax Authority" — the revenue authority issuing queries, audit
  findings, and assessments.
Pool "External Tax Adviser" — external advisers providing opinions,
  review support, and documentation assistance.
Pool "Document Management System" — the system storing and retrieving
  workpapers and supporting documentation.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Tax Authority" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "External Tax Adviser" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Document Management System" — black-box, System = true,
  single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Tax Authority
2. Organisation
3. External Tax Adviser
4. Document Management System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Tax lane:

Message start event "Query or audit notification received from Tax
  Authority"
User task "Log and classify query or audit"
Exclusive gateway "Query or audit?"
  - branch "query": User task "Assess scope and nature of query"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Query or Audit resolved")
  - branch "audit": User task "Assess audit scope and prepare
    audit response plan"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Query or Audit resolved")
Exclusive merge gateway "Query or Audit resolved"
User task "Identify relevant transactions and tax positions"
Service task "Retrieve supporting documentation from Document
  Management System"
Exclusive gateway "External adviser input needed?"
  - branch "yes": Send task "Engage external tax adviser"
    Intermediate message catch event "Adviser opinion received"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Adviser input resolved")
  - branch "no": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
    "Adviser input resolved")
Exclusive merge gateway "Adviser input resolved"
User task "Compile response and supporting evidence package"
Exclusive gateway "Legal review required?"
  - branch "yes": User task "Request legal review"
    Intermediate message catch event "Legal review complete"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Legal review resolved")
  - branch "no": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
    "Legal review resolved")
Exclusive merge gateway "Legal review resolved"
User task "Finalise and approve response"
Send task "Submit response to Tax Authority"
Intermediate message catch event "Tax Authority determination received"
Exclusive gateway "Determination outcome?"
  - branch "accepted — no further action": End event "Query or audit
    closed — no balance adjustment required"
  - branch "assessment or adjustment raised": User task "Record agreed
    tax adjustment and update tax position"
    Service task "Store final outcome in Document Management System"
    End event "Audit outcome confirmed — ready for Pay or Claim Balance"
  - branch "disputed — objection required":
    Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Objection Resolved" (standard loop)
      containing, in order: User task "Draft formal objection",
      User task "Submit objection to Tax Authority",
      Intermediate message catch event "Objection outcome received"
    User task "Record objection outcome and update tax position"
    Service task "Store objection outcome in Document Management System"
    End event "Audit outcome confirmed — ready for Pay or Claim Balance"

Legal lane:

User task "Conduct legal review of response and tax positions"
User task "Advise on objection strategy if disputed"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on User task "Compile response and
  supporting evidence package" — label "Response deadline reached" —
  triggers Send task "Submit holding response to Tax Authority" which
  flows to an End event "Holding response submitted — follow-up required".
Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
  Objection Resolved" — label "Objection deadline reached" — triggers
  End event "Objection window expired — escalate to legal".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: within the Organisation pool the Tax lane carries the
  main sequence from start through classification, scoping, document
  retrieval, optional adviser and legal branches (each merging at their
  respective exclusive merge gateways), response compilation, submission,
  and determination handling; the "disputed" branch loops inside the
  standard-loop subprocess then exits to record and store the outcome;
  the Legal lane tasks are sequenced by the "Legal review required" branch
  and feed back to the merge gateway; timer boundary events break out to
  their own end events without rejoining the main flow.

Message flows:
Tax Authority → Organisation / Tax lane (query or audit notification,
  determination, objection outcome).
Organisation / Tax lane → Tax Authority (compiled response package,
  formal objection, holding response).
Organisation / Tax lane → External Tax Adviser (request for adviser
  opinion and documentation support).
External Tax Adviser → Organisation / Tax lane (adviser opinion and
  review findings).
Organisation / Tax lane → Document Management System (supporting
  documentation retrieval request, final outcome storage).
Document Management System → Organisation / Tax lane (retrieved
  workpapers and supporting documentation).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Query or Audit Notification" — written by Message start
  event "Query or audit notification received from Tax Authority";
  read by User task "Log and classify query or audit".
Data Object "Audit Response Plan" — written by User task "Assess audit
  scope and prepare audit response plan"; read by User task "Identify
  relevant transactions and tax positions".
Data Object "Supporting Evidence Package" — written by User task
  "Compile response and supporting evidence package"; read by Send task
  "Submit response to Tax Authority".
Data Object "Adviser Opinion" — written by Intermediate message catch
  event "Adviser opinion received"; read by User task "Compile response
  and supporting evidence package".
Data Object "Legal Review Findings" — written by User task "Conduct
  legal review of response and tax positions"; read by User task
  "Finalise and approve response".
Data Object "Tax Authority Determination" — written by Intermediate
  message catch event "Tax Authority determination received"; read by
  Exclusive gateway "Determination outcome?".
Data Object "Agreed Tax Adjustment Record" — written by User task
  "Record agreed tax adjustment and update tax position"; read by
  Service task "Store final outcome in Document Management System".

V24.09 Respond to Queries & Audits receives notifications of authority
queries, audits, and assessments and coordinates the organisation's
response by retrieving workpapers, engaging external advisers, seeking
legal review where needed, and submitting evidenced replies or formal
objections. Where the determination results in an agreed tax adjustment
or upheld assessment, the subprocess records the updated tax position
and hands the confirmed balance to V24.08 Pay or Claim Balance for
settlement.
```

```text
keep the organisation's tax treatment and reporting current.

Pool "Organisation" — the organisation running the monitoring and
  response process, containing the Tax lane.
Pool "External Tax Adviser" — specialist advisers who provide legislative
  analysis, alerts and guidance.
Pool "Tax Reporting System" — IT system used to update tax rules,
  parameters and provision calculations.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "External Tax Adviser" — black-box, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. External Tax Adviser
2. Organisation
3. Tax Reporting System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Organisation)

Tax lane:
  Message start event "Legislative change alert received from External
    Tax Adviser or Tax Authority"
  User task "Log and register legislative change"
  User task "Assess materiality and applicability to organisation"
  Exclusive gateway "Material and applicable?"
  - branch "No — not applicable or immaterial": End event "Change
      recorded as not applicable — no further action"
  - branch "Yes — material and applicable":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Material and applicable")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Material and applicable"
  User task "Assign change to subject-matter specialist"
  User task "Conduct detailed impact analysis"
  Exclusive gateway "External advice required?"
  - branch "Yes — external expertise needed": Send task "Request
      detailed advice from External Tax Adviser"
      Intermediate message catch event "Adviser opinion received"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "External advice required")
  - branch "No — in-house analysis sufficient":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "External advice required")
  Exclusive merge gateway "External advice required"
  User task "Prepare impact assessment report"
  User task "Present findings to tax manager for sign-off"
  Exclusive gateway "Assessment approved?"
  - branch "No — revision required":
      Expanded Subprocess "Revise Until Assessment Approved"
        (standard loop) containing, in order: User task "Revise impact
        assessment", User task "Resubmit to tax manager for sign-off"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Assessment approved")
  - branch "Yes — approved":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Assessment approved")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Assessment approved"
  User task "Update tax determination rules and parameters in Tax
    Reporting System"
  Service task "Confirm rule updates saved in Tax Reporting System"
  User task "Communicate changes to affected teams and stakeholders"
  User task "Update tax governance documentation and procedures"
  Exclusive gateway "Monitoring period ongoing?"
  - branch "Yes — further changes expected": Intermediate timer catch
      event "Next scheduled monitoring review due"
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Monitoring period ongoing")
  - branch "No — monitoring cycle complete":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Monitoring period ongoing")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Monitoring period ongoing"
  End event "Legislative change embedded — tax framework current"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on "Conduct detailed impact analysis"
  labelled "Impact analysis overdue" — triggers User task "Escalate
  delayed impact analysis to tax manager".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: work proceeds through the Tax lane from the message
  start event through logging, materiality assessment, and the
  "Material and applicable?" gateway; the not-applicable branch ends
  immediately while the applicable branch continues through specialist
  assignment, impact analysis, the "External advice required?" gateway
  (whose yes-branch sends a request and waits for the adviser reply
  before merging), approval, the revision subprocess loop if rejected,
  then rule updates, communication, documentation, and the monitoring
  continuation gateway before reaching the end event.

Message flows:
  External Tax Adviser → Organisation Tax lane (legislative change alert
    and analysis delivered at start)
  Organisation Tax lane Send task "Request detailed advice from External
    Tax Adviser" → External Tax Adviser (request for detailed legislative
    opinion)
  External Tax Adviser → Organisation Tax lane Intermediate message catch
    event "Adviser opinion received" (written opinion and guidance
    returned)
  Organisation Tax lane "Update tax determination rules and parameters in
    Tax Reporting System" → Tax Reporting System (updated rules and rate
    parameters)
  Tax Reporting System → Organisation Tax lane Service task "Confirm rule
    updates saved in Tax Reporting System" (confirmation of saved updates)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Legislative Change Register" — written by "Log and register
  legislative change"; read by "Assess materiality and applicability to

Data Object "Impact Assessment Report" — written by "Prepare impact
  assessment report"; read by "Present findings to tax manager for
  sign-off".

  event "Adviser opinion received"; read by "Prepare impact assessment
  report".
Data Object "Updated Tax Governance Documentation" — written by "Update
  tax governance documentation and procedures"; read by "Communicate
  changes to affected teams and stakeholders".

V24.10 Monitor Legislative Change completes the Transaction to Return
value chain by ensuring that enacted or proposed tax law changes are
captured, assessed for materiality, and translated into updated rules and
procedures within the Tax Reporting System. It hands the organisation a
current and governance-compliant tax framework, giving every upstream
subprocess — from transaction capture through to lodgement and payment —
the correct determination rules and documented basis for the next
reporting cycle.
```

## V25 — Data to Insight

**Teams and roles involved.**
Data to Insight usually involves Data Engineering, Data Platform/Operations, Analytics and Business Intelligence, Data Governance and Stewardship, Privacy, and the consuming Business Units. Key roles include data engineer, platform engineer, analytics engineer, data analyst, data scientist, data steward, data owner, privacy officer, and the business sponsor who acts on the result.

**External participants.**
The main external participants are Data Providers — third-party data vendors, partners and public data sources — and, where analytics affects them, the Data Subjects whose information is used. The process is initiated by a business question, a scheduled reporting cycle, a new data source becoming available, or a model requiring retraining. Other external parties include cloud and tooling vendors, and regulators where automated decision-making is in scope.

**High-level subprocesses.**
Typical subprocesses are: capture the business question and success measure, identify and assess sources, ingest data, validate quality and profile it, transform and model it, catalogue and document lineage, build the analysis, model or report, review and validate the result, publish and enable access, and monitor usage, accuracy and drift.

**Typical IT systems.**
Supporting systems include ingestion and pipeline orchestration, data lake and warehouse platforms, transformation tooling, data quality and observability, the data catalogue and lineage store, business intelligence and visualisation, machine-learning platforms and feature stores, access management, and cost and usage monitoring.

**Policies and procedures.**
Key controls include data governance framework and ownership, data classification and handling rules, privacy and consent constraints on secondary use, data quality standards and thresholds, model risk management and validation requirements, access and least-privilege rules, retention and deletion schedules, and change control for pipelines and published reports.

**Information flow between external participants and process.**
Data providers supply feeds, extracts, schemas and licence terms, and receive usage reporting or payment. Data subjects exercise access, correction and deletion rights, which the process must honour across the platform. Business sponsors provide the question, context and acceptance of results, and receive insights, dashboards and recommendations.

**Information flow between process and IT systems.**
The process creates or updates ingestion jobs, curated datasets, transformation logic, quality rules and results, catalogue entries and lineage, models and their versions, dashboards and reports, and access grants. IT systems provide source schemas and volumes, pipeline run status and failures, quality metrics, model performance and drift signals, and usage, cost and adoption reporting.

**Process ↔ Actors / Teams / IT Systems association matrix.**

Each row matches the pools, lanes and roles of the corresponding BPMN process
prompt below — external actors are the non-organisation pools, teams are the
lanes of the "Organisation" pool (key role in brackets), and IT systems are the
`System = true` black-box pools.

| Process | External Actors | Teams (key role) | IT Systems |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **V25.01** Capture Business Question | Business Sponsor | Analytics (data analyst) | Business Intelligence Platform |
| **V25.02** Identify & Assess Sources | Data Provider | Data Engineering (data engineer), Data Governance (data steward) | Data Catalogue |
| **V25.03** Ingest Data | Data Provider | Data Engineering (data engineer) | Ingestion & Orchestration Platform, Data Lake |
| **V25.04** Validate Quality & Profile | — | Data Engineering (data engineer), Data Governance (data steward) | Data Quality & Observability Platform |
| **V25.05** Transform & Model Data | — | Analytics Engineering (analytics engineer) | Transformation Tooling, Data Warehouse |
| **V25.06** Catalogue & Document Lineage | — | Data Governance (data steward) | Data Catalogue |
| **V25.07** Build Analysis, Model or Report | — | Analytics (data analyst), Data Science (data scientist) | Business Intelligence Platform, Machine Learning Platform |
| **V25.08** Review & Validate Result | Business Sponsor | Analytics (data analyst), Data Governance (data owner) | Business Intelligence Platform |
| **V25.09** Publish & Enable Access | Data Subject | Data Platform (platform engineer), Privacy (privacy officer) | Business Intelligence Platform, Access Management System |
| **V25.10** Monitor Usage, Accuracy & Drift | — | Data Platform (platform engineer), Data Science (data scientist) | Data Quality & Observability Platform, Machine Learning Platform |

**Actor / Team / System roll-up** (every distinct participant across V25):

- **External actors:** Business Sponsor (V25.01, V25.08); Data Provider (V25.02, V25.03); Data Subject (V25.09).
- **Teams:** Analytics (V25.01, V25.07, V25.08); Data Engineering (V25.02–V25.04); Data Governance (V25.02, V25.04, V25.06, V25.08); Analytics Engineering (V25.05); Data Science (V25.07, V25.10); Data Platform (V25.09, V25.10); Privacy (V25.09).
- **IT systems:** Business Intelligence Platform (V25.01, V25.07–V25.09); Data Catalogue (V25.02, V25.06); Ingestion & Orchestration Platform (V25.03); Data Lake (V25.03); Data Quality & Observability Platform (V25.04, V25.10); Transformation Tooling (V25.05); Data Warehouse (V25.05); Machine Learning Platform (V25.07, V25.10); Access Management System (V25.09).

```text
ArchiMate: V25 — Data to Insight — Service & Application Landscape
(high level).

Purpose: This view shows the end-to-end service and application landscape
for the Data to Insight value chain, from the initial business question
through to ongoing monitoring of published insights. The layout uses three
horizontal bands, top to bottom: BUSINESS SERVICES → BUSINESS PROCESSES →
APPLICATIONS. The demand-side actor (Business Sponsor) sits on the far
left; supply-side external participants (Data Provider, Data Subject) sit
on the far right. The view is read top-to-bottom as service → process →
application, expressing ArchiMate service realisation across the chain.

1. Business Actors (Business Actor)

- Business Sponsor: demand-side actor, far left; initiates the chain by
  providing the business question and accepts the resulting insights.
- Data Provider: supply-side actor, far right; supplies data feeds,
  extracts, schemas and licence terms to the ingestion steps.
- Data Subject: supply-side actor, far right; exercises access, correction
  and deletion rights affecting published data.

2. Interfaces

- Business Question Interface: accessed by Business Sponsor; serves the
  Question Framing & Scoping service and the Insight Delivery service.
- Data Supply Interface: accessed by Data Provider; serves the Source
  Assessment & Ingestion service.
- Data Rights Interface: accessed by Data Subject; serves the Governed
  Access & Publishing service.

3. Business Services (Business Service) — top band, left to right

- Question Framing & Scoping: captures and structures the business
  question, success measure and scope before any data work begins.
- Source Assessment & Ingestion: identifies, assesses, licences and
  ingests data from internal and external providers.
- Data Quality & Validation: profiles ingested data, enforces quality
  standards and thresholds, and gates downstream use.
- Data Transformation & Modelling: transforms raw data into curated,
  analytical models ready for analysis.
- Cataloguing & Lineage: registers datasets, documents lineage and
  maintains the authoritative metadata record.
- Analysis, Modelling & Reporting: builds analyses, statistical or ML
  models, dashboards and reports against curated data.
- Review & Acceptance: validates results against the business question,
  quality standards and model risk requirements.
- Governed Access & Publishing: publishes approved insights and manages
  access under least-privilege and privacy controls.
- Usage, Accuracy & Drift Monitoring: continuously monitors consumption,
  model accuracy and data drift across the platform.

4. Business Processes (Business Process) — middle band, in chain order

- V25.01 Capture Business Question
- V25.02 Identify & Assess Sources
- V25.03 Ingest Data
- V25.04 Validate Quality & Profile
- V25.05 Transform & Model Data
- V25.06 Catalogue & Document Lineage
- V25.07 Build Analysis, Model or Report
- V25.08 Review & Validate Result
- V25.09 Publish & Enable Access
- V25.10 Monitor Usage, Accuracy & Drift

5. Application Components (Application Component) — bottom band

- Business Intelligence Platform: supports question capture, report and
  dashboard building, result review and published access.
- Data Catalogue: supports source assessment and lineage documentation.
- Ingestion & Orchestration Platform: supports pipeline creation and
  scheduled data ingestion.
- Data Lake: stores raw ingested data at scale.
- Data Quality & Observability Platform: supports quality profiling,
  validation and ongoing drift monitoring.
- Transformation Tooling: supports transformation logic authoring and
  execution.
- Data Warehouse: stores curated, modelled analytical datasets.
- Machine Learning Platform: supports model building, versioning and
  serving; includes feature store capability.
- Access Management System: enforces access grants and least-privilege
  rules at publication.

6. Relationships

SERVING (business service serves business actor or process)

- Source Assessment & Ingestion serves Data Provider.
- Governed Access & Publishing serves Data Subject.
- Governed Access & Publishing serves Business Sponsor.
```

```text
business question and its success measure. Starting from a sponsor's
initial request, it iterates through clarification and confirmation
rounds until both parties agree on a scoped brief. The approved brief

agreed statement of what data is needed and how the result will be
```
