**Value Chain diagram prompt.**

```text
Value Chain V26 - Concept to Commissioning

Lay out a single left-to-right sequence of ten high-level process stages,
each represented as a chevron, in the order listed below. The chevrons
flow from left to right with no branching. Use exactly the stage names
and codes given.

V26.01. Develop Concept & Business Case
V26.02. Obtain Funding Approval
V26.03. Perform Detailed Design
V26.04. Obtain Permits & Approvals
V26.05. Procure Contractors & Equipment
V26.06. Mobilise & Construct
V26.07. Manage Variations & Claims
V26.08. Inspect & Test
V26.09. Commission & Hand Over
V26.10. Capitalise Asset & Close Project

This chain transforms a capital proposal — arising from growth, asset
replacement, compliance obligation or risk — into an operational asset
recorded on the fixed-asset ledger. It begins when a project sponsor
advances an initial concept and business case through internal stage
gates and ends when the commissioned asset is handed to Operations and
formally capitalised by Finance. Contractors and Consultants are the
primary external participants, delivering design, construction and
testing work across the middle stages of the chain, while the Regulator
grants the permits and approvals without which construction cannot
proceed.
```
### V26.01 — Develop Concept & Business Case

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V26.01 Develop Concept & Business Case — first subprocess in the
Concept to Commissioning value chain, converting a capital proposal into an
approved business case ready for funding approval.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Project Organisation" — the internal organisation developing the concept
and business case, with Capital Planning and Engineering lanes.
Pool "Capital Portfolio Management System" — IT system recording business cases,
stage gates and portfolio data.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Project Organisation": white-box, single instance.
Pool "Capital Portfolio Management System": black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Project Organisation (white-box, contains all process flow)
2. Capital Portfolio Management System (black-box, IT system at bottom)

4. Lane contents in flow order (Project Organisation)

Capital Planning lane (project sponsor):
  None start event "Capital proposal received — growth, replacement, compliance
    or risk trigger"
  User task "Register capital proposal and assign project sponsor"
  User task "Define project scope and strategic objectives"
  User task "Commission feasibility assessment"
  Intermediate message catch event "Feasibility assessment results received"
  Exclusive gateway "Feasibility viable?"
    - branch "Not viable": End event "Proposal rejected — concept not pursued"
    - branch "Viable": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Feasibility
      viable?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Feasibility viable?"
  User task "Initiate business case development"
  User task "Review and assemble full business case"
  Exclusive gateway "Business case complete and acceptable?"
    - branch "Incomplete or requires revision":
      Expanded Subprocess "Revise Until Business Case Acceptable"
        (standard loop) containing, in order:
        User task "Document required revisions",
        User task "Return business case to owning team for revision",
        Intermediate message catch event "Revised business case received"
    - branch "Complete and acceptable":
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Business case complete and
      acceptable?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Business case complete and acceptable?"
  User task "Endorse business case and recommend for funding approval"
  Service task "Record stage-gate outcome in Capital Portfolio Management System"
  End event "Business case endorsed — ready for Obtain Funding Approval"

Engineering lane (cost estimator):
  User task "Develop preliminary cost estimate and schedule"
  User task "Identify and assess project risks"
  User task "Prepare options analysis and preferred solution"
  User task "Compile supporting technical documentation"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Revise Until Business
Case Acceptable": label "Revision deadline exceeded" — triggers End event
"Business case abandoned — revision deadline exceeded".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: flow begins in the Capital Planning lane with the None start
event and proceeds through proposal registration, scope definition and
feasibility commissioning. After the intermediate message catch event the
Exclusive gateway "Feasibility viable?" splits; the "Not viable" branch ends
at its own End event while the "Viable" branch rejoins at the exclusive merge
gateway. Flow then continues to initiation of business case development, at
which point the Engineering lane tasks — cost estimating, risk assessment,
options analysis and technical documentation — are triggered in parallel before
the Capital Planning lane receives results and assembles the full business case.
The "Business case complete and acceptable?" gateway splits; the "Incomplete or
requires revision" branch enters the standard-loop subprocess (with its timer
boundary event leading to an abandonment End event if the deadline is exceeded)
and the "Complete and acceptable" branch rejoins at the corresponding exclusive
merge gateway. Flow concludes with endorsement, system recording and the end
event handing off to Obtain Funding Approval.

Message flows:
Capital Portfolio Management System → User task "Register capital proposal and
  assign project sponsor" (portfolio register and proposal data).
Service task "Record stage-gate outcome in Capital Portfolio Management System"
  → Capital Portfolio Management System (stage-gate result and endorsed
  business case record).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Capital Proposal" — written by User task "Register capital proposal
  and assign project sponsor"; read by User task "Define project scope and
  strategic objectives".
Data Object "Feasibility Assessment Report" — written by Engineering during User
  task "Develop preliminary cost estimate and schedule" and User task "Prepare
  options analysis and preferred solution"; read by Capital Planning at
  Intermediate message catch event "Feasibility assessment results received".
Data Object "Preliminary Cost Estimate" — written by User task "Develop
  preliminary cost estimate and schedule"; read by User task "Review and
  assemble full business case".
Data Object "Risk Register" — written by User task "Identify and assess project
  risks"; read by User task "Review and assemble full business case".
Data Object "Business Case" — written by User task "Initiate business case
  development" and updated through revision; read by User task "Endorse business
  case and recommend for funding approval" and by Service task "Record
  stage-gate outcome in Capital Portfolio Management System".

This subprocess converts an initial capital proposal into a fully assembled,
sponsor-endorsed business case supported by a cost estimate, risk register and
options analysis. It applies a feasibility gate to screen out unviable proposals
early and a revision loop to bring incomplete business cases to the required
standard. The endorsed business case and stage-gate record it produces are
passed to Obtain Funding Approval, where they are submitted to decision-makers
and, where applicable, external financiers.
```


### V26.02 — Obtain Funding Approval

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V26.02 Obtain Funding Approval — the second subprocess in the
Concept to Commissioning value chain, converting an approved business case
into a formal funding commitment before detailed design begins.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Project Organisation" — the internal teams executing the funding
approval process, with lanes for Capital Planning and Finance.
Pool "Financier" — external party providing or confirming external funding
where the project is externally funded.
Pool "Capital Portfolio Management System" — IT system recording approvals,
stage gates, budgets and forecast positions.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Project Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Financier" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Capital Portfolio Management System" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Financier
2. Project Organisation
3. Capital Portfolio Management System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Project Organisation)

Capital Planning lane:
  Message start event "Approved business case received from Develop
  Concept & Business Case"
  User task "Review business case and confirm funding requirement"
  User task "Prepare funding submission and stage-gate pack"
  Service task "Submit stage-gate pack to Capital Portfolio Management
  System"
  User task "Present funding submission to approval authority"
  Exclusive gateway "Funding approved at required threshold?"
  - branch "approved": User task "Record funding approval and authorised
    budget" (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Funding approved at
    required threshold?")
  - branch "rejected or deferred": User task "Document rejection or
    deferral decision"
    End event "Funding not approved — project on hold or cancelled"
  - branch "approved with conditions": User task "Capture approval
    conditions and required actions"
    Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until Conditions Cleared" (standard loop)
    containing, in order: User task "Address approval conditions", User
    task "Resubmit evidence of conditions met", Intermediate message
    catch event "Conditions acceptance received from approval authority"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Funding approved at required
    threshold?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Funding approved at required threshold?"
  Exclusive gateway "External funding required?"
  - branch "yes — external funding": Send task "Issue external funding
    request to Financier"
    Intermediate message catch event "External funding confirmation
    received from Financier"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "External funding required?")
  - branch "no — internal funding only": (continues to exclusive merge
    gateway "External funding required?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "External funding required?"
  Service task "Register approved budget in Capital Portfolio Management
  System"
  User task "Issue project budget allocation to project manager"

Finance lane:
  User task "Validate cost estimate and affordability assessment"
  User task "Confirm capitalisation classification for budget"
  User task "Update forecast position upon funding confirmation"
  End event "Funding approved and budget allocated — ready for Perform
  Detailed Design"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
Conditions Cleared" — labelled "Condition clearance deadline exceeded" —
flow proceeds to User task "Escalate unresolved conditions to project
sponsor".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: Work begins in the Capital Planning lane with the message
start event, moves through business case review, submission preparation,
system lodgement and presentation to the approval authority. The exclusive
gateway "Funding approved at required threshold?" branches to three paths:
the rejection branch ends at its own end event; the conditions branch
enters the loop subprocess and, once conditions are cleared, rejoins the
merge gateway; the approved branch rejoins the merge gateway directly. From
the merge, the external-funding gateway branches to the send-task path
(which waits for Financier confirmation) and the internal-only path, both
rejoining the second merge gateway. From that merge, budget registration
and allocation flow into the Finance lane for affordability validation,
capitalisation classification, and forecast update, closing at the end
event.

Message flows:
Capital Planning lane "Submit stage-gate pack to Capital Portfolio
Management System" → Capital Portfolio Management System (stage-gate pack
and funding submission).
Capital Portfolio Management System → Capital Planning lane "Present
funding submission to approval authority" (current budget, prior actuals
and portfolio position).
Capital Planning lane "Register approved budget in Capital Portfolio
Management System" → Capital Portfolio Management System (approved budget
and funding decision).
Capital Portfolio Management System → Finance lane "Update forecast
position upon funding confirmation" (updated budget and forecast data).
Capital Planning lane "Issue external funding request to Financier" →
Financier (funding request and project business case summary).
Financier → Capital Planning lane intermediate message catch event
"External funding confirmation received from Financier" (funding
commitment confirmation).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Business Case" — read by User task "Review business case and
confirm funding requirement".
Data Object "Funding Submission Pack" — written by User task "Prepare
funding submission and stage-gate pack"; read by User task "Present
funding submission to approval authority".
Data Object "Approval Conditions Register" — written by User task "Capture
approval conditions and required actions"; read by User task "Address
approval conditions".
Data Object "Funding Approval Record" — written by User task "Record
funding approval and authorised budget"; read by Service task "Register
approved budget in Capital Portfolio Management System".
Data Object "Project Budget Allocation" — written by User task "Issue
project budget allocation to project manager"; read by Finance lane User
task "Update forecast position upon funding confirmation".
Data Object "Affordability Assessment" — written by Finance lane User task
"Validate cost estimate and affordability assessment"; read by Finance lane
User task "Confirm capitalisation classification for budget".

V26.02 secures the formal funding commitment and authorised project budget
that the organisation needs before committing to detailed design
expenditure. It validates affordability, classifies spend as capital,
confirms any external financing, and records the stage-gate decision in the
Capital Portfolio Management System. The approved budget allocation and
funding record are handed to V26.03 Perform Detailed Design as the
financial authority under which design work proceeds.
```

```text
  Exclusive merge gateway "Design packages check resolved"
  User task "Compile design deliverables register"
  End event "Detailed design complete — ready for Obtain Permits &
    Approvals"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on User task "Review draft design
  deliverables" — label "Review period exceeded (10 business days)" —
  triggers Send task "Issue overdue review notice to Consultant" then
  rejoins flow after the review task.

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: flow runs entirely within the Engineering lane from the
  message start event through scope definition, brief issuance, receipt
  of draft deliverables, review and the exclusive gateway; the
  "Revisions required" branch issues comments and awaits revised
  deliverables before merging at "Design review outcome resolved"; the
  "Accepted" branch merges directly at the same gateway; flow then
  continues through approval, document control registration, internal
  sign-off, and the completeness gateway; both branches of "All design
  packages complete?" merge at "Design packages check resolved" before
  the register compilation and end event.

Message flows:
  Send task "Transmit design brief and reference documents" →
    Consultant (design brief, scope of work, reference documents).
  Consultant → Intermediate message catch event "Draft design
    deliverables received from Consultant" (draft drawings,
    specifications, calculations).
  Send task "Issue review comments to Consultant" →
    Consultant (design review comments and mark-ups).
  Consultant → Intermediate message catch event "Revised deliverables
    received from Consultant" (revised drawings and specifications).
  Service task "Register approved drawings in Engineering Design &
    Document Control" → Engineering Design & Document Control
    (approved drawings, document register update).
  Engineering Design & Document Control → User task "Conduct internal
    design review and sign-off" (current document register, version
    status).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Design Brief" — written by User task "Define design scope
  and terms of reference"; read by Send task "Transmit design brief and
  reference documents".
Data Object "Draft Design Deliverables" — written by Intermediate
  message catch event "Draft design deliverables received from
  Consultant"; read by User task "Review draft design deliverables".
Data Object "Review Comments" — written by User task "Review draft
  design deliverables"; read by Send task "Issue review comments to
  Consultant".
Data Object "Approved Design Package" — written by User task "Approve
  and issue design for document control"; read by Service task
  "Register approved drawings in Engineering Design & Document Control".
Data Object "Design Deliverables Register" — written by User task
  "Compile design deliverables register"; read by End event "Detailed
  design complete — ready for Obtain Permits & Approvals".

This subprocess transforms the approved business case into a complete
set of reviewed and registered engineering design deliverables. The
Engineering lane coordinates scope definition, issues a design brief to
the external Consultant, manages iterative review cycles until all
packages are accepted, and records the finalised drawings in the
Engineering Design & Document Control system. The completed design
deliverables register is then handed to Obtain Permits & Approvals,
which uses the approved drawings and specifications as the basis for
regulatory submissions.
```


### V26.04 — Obtain Permits & Approvals

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V26.04 Obtain Permits & Approvals — the fourth subprocess in the
Concept to Commissioning value chain, sitting between Perform Detailed

Pool "Regulator" — black-box, single instance.

Pool "Document Management System" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

1. Regulator
2. Community Stakeholder
3. Project Organisation
4. Document Management System

Project Management lane:

  User task "Prepare permit applications and supporting documents"

Health & Safety lane:

Sequence flows: flow begins in the Project Management lane with

and lodgement, then community consultation tasks before moving to
the "Permit granted?" gateway; the "Yes" branch and the returning
"No" branch (after resubmission) both converge at the exclusive
merge gateway "Permit granted", continuing to record conditions
and the end event. The Health & Safety lane tasks run in
parallel, with "Compile safety-in-design evidence" feeding
documents into "Prepare permit applications and supporting
documents", and "Review permit conditions" attached after the

Message flows:

application package lodged).
Project Management → Community Stakeholder (community
consultation notice issued).
Community Stakeholder → Project Management (community submissions
received).
Project Management → Regulator (permit applications and

7. Data objects

This subprocess takes the approved design package and secures all

construction begins. It coordinates application preparation,
```

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V26.05 Procure Contractors & Equipment — the procurement subprocess
within Concept to Commissioning, triggered by completed detailed design and

1. Pools & Lanes

and delivery work.
Pool "Equipment Vendor" — external suppliers submitting quotations for

Pool "Project Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Contractor" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Equipment Vendor" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Procurement & Contract Management" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Contractor
2. Equipment Vendor
3. Project Organisation
4. Procurement & Contract Management

4. Lane contents in flow order (Project Organisation)

Procurement lane:
  Message start event "Permits and approved design received from
  Obtain Permits & Approvals"
  User task "Define procurement strategy and package scope"
  User task "Prepare tender documents and specifications"
  Parallel gateway "Initiate parallel procurement streams"
  - branch "Contractor procurement":
      Send task "Issue invitation to tender to Contractor"
      Intermediate message catch event "Tenders received from Contractor"
      User task "Evaluate contractor tenders"
      User task "Conduct contractor clarification and negotiation"
      Exclusive gateway "Contractor tender acceptable?"
      - branch "Yes":
          User task "Award contract to Contractor"
          Service task "Record contract in Procurement & Contract
          Management"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Contractor
          procurement complete")
      - branch "No":
          User task "Revise scope or re-tender for contractor"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Contractor
          procurement complete")
      Exclusive merge gateway "Contractor procurement complete"
  - branch "Equipment procurement":
      Send task "Issue request for quotation to Equipment Vendor"
      Intermediate message catch event "Quotations received from
      Equipment Vendor"
      User task "Evaluate equipment quotations"
      User task "Conduct vendor clarification and negotiation"
      Exclusive gateway "Equipment quotation acceptable?"
      - branch "Yes":
          User task "Raise purchase order for equipment"
          Service task "Record purchase order in Procurement &
          Contract Management"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Equipment
          procurement complete")
      - branch "No":
          User task "Revise specification or re-quote for equipment"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Equipment
          procurement complete")
      Exclusive merge gateway "Equipment procurement complete"
  Parallel merge gateway "All procurement streams complete"
  User task "Confirm mobilisation readiness and handover package"
  End event "Contracts awarded and orders placed — ready for Mobilise
  & Construct"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on "Evaluate contractor tenders" —
label "Tender evaluation period exceeded" — triggers User task "Escalate
tender evaluation to procurement lead" which then flows back to the
exclusive merge gateway "Contractor procurement complete".
Interrupting timer boundary event on "Evaluate equipment quotations" —
label "Quotation evaluation period exceeded" — triggers User task
"Escalate quotation evaluation to procurement lead" which then flows
back to the exclusive merge gateway "Equipment procurement complete".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: the Procurement lane begins at the message start event,
advances through strategy and document preparation tasks, then splits at
the parallel gateway into the contractor procurement branch and the
equipment procurement branch. The contractor branch runs through tender
issuance, receipt, evaluation, negotiation, and the acceptable gateway;
the Yes branch records the contract and rejoins the contractor
exclusive merge gateway; the No branch re-tenders and rejoins the same
merge gateway. The equipment branch runs through quotation issuance,
receipt, evaluation, negotiation, and the acceptable gateway; the Yes
branch records the purchase order and rejoins the equipment exclusive
merge gateway; the No branch re-quotes and rejoins the same merge

gateway, which advances to the readiness confirmation task and on to

Message flows:
Send task "Issue invitation to tender to Contractor" → Contractor
(invitation to tender package including scope and specifications).
Contractor → Intermediate message catch event "Tenders received from

Send task "Issue request for quotation to Equipment Vendor" →
Equipment Vendor (request for quotation with technical specification).
Equipment Vendor → Intermediate message catch event "Quotations
received from Equipment Vendor" (equipment quotations and lead-time
details).
Service task "Record contract in Procurement & Contract Management" →
Procurement & Contract Management (awarded contract data).
Service task "Record purchase order in Procurement & Contract
Management" → Procurement & Contract Management (purchase order data).
Procurement & Contract Management → User task "Confirm mobilisation
readiness and handover package" (confirmed contract and order records
for handover package).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Procurement Strategy" — written by "Define procurement
strategy and package scope"; read by "Prepare tender documents and
specifications".
Data Object "Tender Documents" — written by "Prepare tender documents
and specifications"; read by "Issue invitation to tender to Contractor".
Data Object "Request for Quotation" — written by "Prepare tender
documents and specifications"; read by "Issue request for quotation to
Equipment Vendor".
Data Object "Contractor Tender Submissions" — written by intermediate
message catch event "Tenders received from Contractor"; read by
"Evaluate contractor tenders".
Data Object "Equipment Quotations" — written by intermediate message
catch event "Quotations received from Equipment Vendor"; read by
"Evaluate equipment quotations".
Data Object "Awarded Contract" — written by "Award contract to
Contractor"; read by "Record contract in Procurement & Contract
Management".
Data Object "Equipment Purchase Order" — written by "Raise purchase
order for equipment"; read by "Record purchase order in Procurement &
Contract Management".
Data Object "Mobilisation Readiness Package" — written by "Confirm
mobilisation readiness and handover package".

This subprocess converts approved design and permit conditions into
binding contractual and commercial commitments. Running contractor
tendering and equipment procurement in parallel keeps the critical path
as short as possible. When it ends, awarded contracts, confirmed purchase
orders, and a mobilisation readiness package are handed to Mobilise &
Construct so that site work can begin without commercial uncertainty.
```

### V26.06 — Mobilise & Construct

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text

Pool "Site & Safety Management System" — black-box, System = true,

2. Project Organisation (white-box; lanes top to bottom: Construction,
   Health & Safety)
3. Site & Safety Management System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Project Organisation)

Construction lane:
  Message start event "Contracts awarded and equipment orders placed —

Health & Safety lane:
  User task "Conduct pre-construction safety induction and site
    access checks"
  User task "Review and approve Contractor safety management plan"

    - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Safety plan
      acceptable")
    - branch "No": User task "Return safety plan to Contractor for

      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Safety plan acceptable")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Safety plan acceptable"
  User task "Perform routine site safety inspections"

    - branch "No": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Safety

Sequence flows: work begins in the Construction lane with site

This subprocess takes the awarded contracts and equipment orders from
```

### V26.07 — Manage Variations & Claims

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V26.07 Manage Variations & Claims — subprocess within the Concept to
Commissioning value chain, handling contractor-initiated changes and progress
claims during construction.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Project Organisation" — the internal organisation managing variations
  and claims through project management and finance teams.
  Lanes (top to bottom):
  - Project Management (project manager)
  - Finance (cost controller)
Pool "Contractor" — external party submitting variations and progress claims.
Pool "Procurement & Contract Management" — IT system managing contracts,
  variations and purchase orders.
Pool "Cost & Schedule System" — IT system tracking cost actuals, forecasts
  and schedule impacts.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Project Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Contractor" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Procurement & Contract Management" — black-box, System = true,
  single instance.
Pool "Cost & Schedule System" — black-box, System = true, single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Contractor
2. Project Organisation
3. Procurement & Contract Management
4. Cost & Schedule System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Project Organisation)

Project Management lane:
  Message start event "Variation or progress claim received from Mobilise
    & Construct"
  User task "Log and register variation or claim"
  Exclusive gateway "Submission type?"
  - branch "Variation request": User task "Assess variation scope and
      entitlement"
      Exclusive gateway "Variation entitled?"
      - branch "Not entitled": Send task "Issue variation rejection notice"
          End event "Variation rejected — Contractor notified"
      - branch "Entitled": User task "Negotiate and agree variation value"
          Exclusive merge gateway "Variation entitled"
          User task "Issue variation instruction"
          Service task "Record approved variation in Procurement & Contract
            Management"
          Service task "Update cost forecast in Cost & Schedule System"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Submission type")
  - branch "Progress claim": User task "Review progress claim against
      schedule and deliverables"
      Exclusive gateway "Claim substantiated?"
      - branch "Not substantiated": Send task "Issue claim query to
            Contractor"
          Intermediate message catch event "Contractor responds to query"
          User task "Re-assess revised claim submission"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Claim substantiated")
      - branch "Substantiated": Exclusive merge gateway "Claim substantiated"
          User task "Certify claim for payment"
          Service task "Record certified claim in Procurement & Contract
            Management"
          (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Submission type")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Submission type"
  User task "Update variation and claims register"
  Exclusive gateway "Further submissions pending?"
  - branch "Yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Further submissions
      pending")
  - branch "No": Exclusive merge gateway "Further submissions pending"
      End event "Variations and claims resolved — ready for Inspect & Test"

Finance lane:
  User task "Validate cost impact and budget position"
  Service task "Post cost actuals to Cost & Schedule System"
  User task "Approve payment certificate"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Non-interrupting timer boundary event on User task "Negotiate and agree
  variation value" — label "Negotiation deadline exceeded" — triggers Send
  task "Escalate variation to project sponsor" in Project Management lane,
  which flows to End event "Variation escalated for executive resolution".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: Work begins in the Project Management lane with the message
  start event. After logging, the submission-type gateway splits to either the
  variation path or the progress-claim path. On the variation path, the
  entitlement gateway splits to rejection (ending at its own end event) or
  approval (flowing through negotiation, instruction and system recording,
  then looping Finance for cost validation and payment approval before
  returning to the submission-type merge gateway). On the progress-claim path,
  the substantiation gateway splits to a query loop (claim query sent,
  response awaited via intermediate message catch event, re-assessment) or
  direct certification; both branches rejoin at the "Claim substantiated"
  merge gateway before recording and returning to the submission-type merge
  gateway. After the submission-type merge, the register is updated and the
  pending-submissions gateway either loops back or advances to the end event.
  The Finance lane tasks are sequenced after the project manager certifies or
  approves each item and before the submission-type merge.

Message flows:
  Contractor → Project Management lane (variation request or progress claim
    submitted)
  Project Management lane → Contractor (variation rejection notice)
  Project Management lane → Contractor (claim query)
  Contractor → Project Management lane (revised claim submission in response
    to query)
  Project Management lane → Contractor (variation instruction issued)
  Project Management lane → Procurement & Contract Management (approved
    variation recorded)
  Project Management lane → Procurement & Contract Management (certified
    claim recorded)
  Finance lane → Procurement & Contract Management (payment certificate
    posted)
  Finance lane → Cost & Schedule System (cost actuals posted)
  Project Management lane → Cost & Schedule System (cost forecast updated
    after variation approval)
  Cost & Schedule System → Finance lane (budget position and forecast
    returned)
  Procurement & Contract Management → Project Management lane (contract
    and variation register data returned)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Variation Request" — written by User task "Log and register
  variation or claim"; read by User task "Assess variation scope and
  entitlement".
Data Object "Variation Instruction" — written by User task "Issue variation
  instruction"; read by Service task "Record approved variation in
  Procurement & Contract Management".
Data Object "Progress Claim" — written by User task "Log and register
  variation or claim"; read by User task "Review progress claim against
  schedule and deliverables".
Data Object "Payment Certificate" — written by User task "Certify claim for
  payment"; read by User task "Approve payment certificate".
Data Object "Variations and Claims Register" — written by User task "Update
  variation and claims register"; read by User task "Validate cost impact
  and budget position".

This subprocess receives variation requests and progress claims generated
during construction, evaluates entitlement and substantiation, negotiates
and certifies approved amounts, and updates the cost forecast and contract
record accordingly. Rejected variations are closed with a formal notice, and
substantiated claims are certified for payment through Finance. Once all
active submissions are resolved, the consolidated cost position is confirmed
and the process hands a settled variations register and updated budget
forecast to Inspect & Test.
```


### V26.08 — Inspect & Test

```text
Pool "Quality & Inspection Test Plan System" — black-box,
System = true, single instance.

Top to bottom:
1. Certifier
2. Project Organisation
3. Quality & Inspection Test Plan System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Project Organisation)

Quality lane:
  Message start event "Inspection and test phase triggered from
  Mobilise & Construct"
  Service task "Retrieve approved inspection and test plan"
  User task "Schedule inspections and notify parties"
  Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until All ITP Hold Points Cleared"
  (standard loop) containing, in order: User task "Conduct
  inspection at hold point", User task "Record inspection
  result", Exclusive gateway "Inspection passed?",
    - branch "yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Inspection passed?")
    - branch "no": User task "Raise non-conformance report",
      User task "Monitor corrective action", Intermediate
      message catch event "Corrective action completed",
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Inspection
      passed?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Inspection passed?"
  User task "Update inspection and test plan record"
  Exclusive gateway "Witness test required?"
    - branch "yes": Send task "Request certifier witness",
      Intermediate message catch event "Certifier attendance
      confirmed", User task "Conduct witnessed test",
      User task "Record witnessed test result",
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Witness test
      required?")
    - branch "no": User task "Conduct independent test",
      User task "Record independent test result",
      (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Witness test
      required?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Witness test required?"
  Exclusive gateway "Test passed?"
    - branch "no": User task "Raise non-conformance and
      arrange retest", Intermediate message catch event
      "Retest ready", (loop repeats)
    - branch "yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Test passed?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Test passed?"
  Service task "Log final test records in Quality & ITP System"
  Exclusive gateway "All inspection and test items complete?"
    - branch "no": (loop repeats)
    - branch "yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "All inspection and test items complete?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "All inspection and test items complete?"
  User task "Compile inspection and test completion report"
  Intermediate message catch event "Conformance certificate
  received from Certifier"

Commissioning lane:
  User task "Review inspection and test completion report"
  Exclusive gateway "Acceptable for commissioning?"
    - branch "no": User task "Return report with conditions",
      Intermediate message catch event "Conditions addressed
      by Quality", (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Acceptable for commissioning?")
    - branch "yes": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Acceptable for commissioning?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Acceptable for commissioning?"
  User task "Confirm system readiness for commissioning"
  End event "Inspection and test complete — ready for Commission
  & Hand Over"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat
Until All ITP Hold Points Cleared", labelled "ITP overrun
deadline exceeded", leading to User task "Escalate ITP overrun
to project manager" in the Quality lane, then End event "ITP
programme escalated — process suspended".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: work begins in the Quality lane, progresses
through the inspection loop and the witness-test gateway
(branches merging at "Witness test required?"), then the test-
result gateway (branches merging at "Test passed?"), and the
all-items gateway (branches merging at "All inspection and test
items complete?"), before the completion report is compiled and
passed to the Commissioning lane; the Commissioning lane
resolves the "Acceptable for commissioning?" gateway (no branch
loops back via a message catch, yes branch continues) before
confirming readiness and ending.

Message flows:
Quality & Inspection Test Plan System → Quality lane,
"Schedule inspections and notify parties" (inspection and test
plan retrieved).
Quality lane → Quality & Inspection Test Plan System,
"Log final test records in Quality & ITP System" (test results
and ITP status update).
Quality lane → Certifier, "Request certifier witness"
(witness test request and test schedule).
Certifier → Quality lane, "Certifier attendance confirmed"
(attendance confirmation).
Certifier → Quality lane, "Conformance certificate received
from Certifier" (certificate of conformance).
Quality lane → Commissioning lane (internal sequence hand-off
via report; no message flow required — same pool).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Inspection and Test Plan" — read by "Retrieve
approved inspection and test plan"; written by "Update
inspection and test plan record".
Data Object "Non-Conformance Report" — written by "Raise
non-conformance report"; read by "Monitor corrective action".
Data Object "Test Records" — written by "Record witnessed test
result" and "Record independent test result"; read by "Log
final test records in Quality & ITP System".
Data Object "Inspection and Test Completion Report" — written
by "Compile inspection and test completion report"; read by
"Review inspection and test completion report".
Data Object "Conformance Certificate" — written by (Certifier,
external); read by "Confirm system readiness for commissioning".

V26.08 Inspect & Test verifies that every hold point in the
approved inspection and test plan has been cleared, that
non-conformances have been closed out, and that all required
tests — whether witnessed by the certifier or conducted
independently — have returned acceptable results. A completed
inspection and test report, backed by the certifier's
conformance certificate, is handed to the Commissioning lane
for sign-off. Once the commissioning engineer confirms system
readiness, the subprocess closes and hands a fully evidenced
test dossier to V26.09 Commission & Hand Over.
```


### V26.09 — Commission & Hand Over

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V26.09 Commission & Hand Over — the subprocess in which the
Project Organisation formally commissions the constructed asset, witnesses
acceptance testing, and transfers operational control to Operations, sitting
between Inspect & Test and Capitalise Asset & Close Project in the
Concept to Commissioning value chain.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Project Organisation" — the internal organisation delivering the
capital project, containing the Commissioning and Operations lanes.
  Lane "Commissioning" — commissioning engineer leading system
  energisation, test witnessing and handover documentation.
  Lane "Operations" — operations representative accepting the asset
  and signing off on handover.
Pool "Contractor" — external party executing commissioning activities,
providing as-built documentation and attending final acceptance.
Pool "Commissioning & Handover System" — IT system recording
commissioning checklists, test evidence and handover certificates.
Pool "Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)" — IT system receiving the new
asset record on handover acceptance.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Project Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Contractor" — black-box, single instance.
Pool "Commissioning & Handover System" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.
Pool "Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Contractor
2. Project Organisation
3. Commissioning & Handover System
4. Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)

4. Lane contents in flow order (Project Organisation)

Commissioning lane:
  Message start event "Inspection and test sign-off received from
  Inspect & Test"
  User task "Review inspection and test records"
  User task "Prepare commissioning plan and pre-commissioning checklist"
  Service task "Upload commissioning plan to Commissioning & Handover
  System"
  Intermediate message catch event "Contractor confirms readiness for
  commissioning"
  User task "Conduct pre-commissioning checks"
  Exclusive gateway "Pre-commissioning checks passed?"
  - branch "No": User task "Raise defect notice and request
    rectification"
    Intermediate message catch event "Contractor confirms rectification
    complete"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Pre-commissioning checks
    passed?")
  - branch "Yes":
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Pre-commissioning checks
    passed?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Pre-commissioning checks passed?"
  Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until All Systems Commissioned"
  (standard loop) containing, in order:
    User task "Energise system and execute commissioning sequence",
    User task "Witness and record commissioning test results",
    Service task "Record test results in Commissioning & Handover
    System",
    Exclusive gateway "System commissioning test passed?",
    - branch "No": User task "Document failure and instruct
      Contractor to rectify",
      Intermediate message catch event "Contractor confirms
      rectification complete",
      (loop repeats)
    - branch "Yes": (exits subprocess)
  User task "Compile commissioning dossier and as-built documentation"
  Service task "Upload as-built documentation and commissioning
  evidence to Commissioning & Handover System"
  User task "Issue provisional acceptance certificate to Contractor"
  Intermediate timer catch event "Defects liability period elapsed"
  User task "Assess outstanding defects and close-out actions"
  Exclusive gateway "Outstanding defects cleared?"
  - branch "No": User task "Issue final defect notice to Contractor"
    Intermediate message catch event "Contractor confirms final
    defects resolved"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Outstanding defects
    cleared?")
  - branch "Yes":
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Outstanding defects
    cleared?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Outstanding defects cleared?"
  User task "Prepare handover package for Operations"
  Send task "Submit handover package to Operations for acceptance"

Operations lane:
  Intermediate message catch event "Handover package received from
  Commissioning"
  User task "Review handover package and conduct operational
  readiness assessment"
  Exclusive gateway "Operations acceptance granted?"
  - branch "No": Send task "Return handover package with objections
    to Commissioning"
    Intermediate message catch event "Revised handover package
    received"
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Operations acceptance
    granted?")
  - branch "Yes":
    (continues to exclusive merge gateway "Operations acceptance
    granted?")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Operations acceptance granted?"
  User task "Sign handover certificate and accept operational
  responsibility"
  Service task "Create asset record in Enterprise Asset Management
  (EAM)"
  Service task "Record final handover status in Commissioning &
  Handover System"
  End event "Asset handed over to Operations — ready for Capitalise
  Asset & Close Project"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
All Systems Commissioned" — label "Maximum commissioning period
exceeded" — triggers End event "Commissioning failed — escalate to
project sponsor".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: flow proceeds top-to-bottom through the Commissioning
lane from the message start event through pre-commissioning checks,
the standard-loop commissioning subprocess, dossier compilation and
provisional acceptance, then through the defects liability timer to
the handover preparation and send task; control then passes to the
Operations lane via a message, through the acceptance gateway and its
merge, to the sign-off tasks and the end event. The "No" branch of
"Pre-commissioning checks passed?" loops via defect notice and
rectification catch event back to the merge; the "No" branch of
"Outstanding defects cleared?" loops via final defect notice and catch
event back to its merge; the "No" branch of "Operations acceptance
granted?" returns via the send task and a catch event to its merge.

Message flows:
Contractor → Commissioning lane "Contractor confirms readiness for
commissioning" (readiness notification)
Commissioning lane → Contractor "Pre-commissioning defect notice"
(defect notice requesting rectification)
Contractor → Commissioning lane "Contractor confirms rectification
complete" (rectification confirmation — pre-commissioning)
Contractor → Commissioning lane "Contractor confirms rectification
complete" (rectification confirmation — within commissioning loop)
Commissioning lane → Contractor "Provisional acceptance certificate"
(provisional acceptance)
Commissioning lane → Contractor "Final defect notice" (final defects
close-out instruction)
Contractor → Commissioning lane "Contractor confirms final defects
resolved" (final defect resolution confirmation)
Commissioning lane → Commissioning & Handover System "Upload
commissioning plan" (commissioning plan record)
Commissioning lane → Commissioning & Handover System "Record test
results" (commissioning test evidence)
Commissioning lane → Commissioning & Handover System "Upload as-built
documentation and commissioning evidence" (dossier and as-builts)
Operations lane → Commissioning & Handover System "Record final
handover status" (handover completion record)
Commissioning lane → Operations lane "Handover package" (handover
package for acceptance)
Operations lane → Commissioning lane "Revised handover package
objections" (objections and required revisions)
Operations lane → Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) "Create asset
record" (new asset data)

7. Data objects

Data Object "Commissioning Plan and Pre-commissioning Checklist" —
written by "Prepare commissioning plan and pre-commissioning
checklist"; read by "Conduct pre-commissioning checks".
Data Object "Commissioning Test Results" — written by "Witness and
record commissioning test results"; read by "Compile commissioning
dossier and as-built documentation".
Data Object "Commissioning Dossier and As-Built Documentation" —
written by "Compile commissioning dossier and as-built documentation";
read by "Prepare handover package for Operations".
Data Object "Provisional Acceptance Certificate" — written by "Issue
provisional acceptance certificate to Contractor"; read by "Assess
outstanding defects and close-out actions".
Data Object "Handover Package" — written by "Prepare handover package
for Operations"; read by "Review handover package and conduct
operational readiness assessment".
Data Object "Handover Certificate" — written by "Sign handover
certificate and accept operational responsibility"; read by "Create
asset record in Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)".

This subprocess takes the inspected and tested works and drives them
through energisation, witnessed commissioning tests and defects
close-out to a signed handover certificate. The Operations
representative confirms readiness, the Commissioning engineer uploads
the complete dossier and as-built evidence, and EAM receives the new
asset record. The accepted asset and its handover certificate are then
passed to Capitalise Asset & Close Project, where the asset is
recognised on the fixed-asset ledger and the project is formally
closed.
```


### V26.10 — Capitalise Asset & Close Project

**BPMN diagram prompt.**

```text
BPMN: V26.10 Capitalise Asset & Close Project — the final subprocess of
Concept to Commissioning, converting completed project costs into fixed-asset
records and formally closing the project.

1. Pools & Lanes

Pool "Project Organisation" — the internal teams executing capitalisation
and project closure.
  Lane "Finance" — asset accountant performing capitalisation entries and
  ledger reconciliation.
  Lane "Project Management" — project manager closing out the project,
  releasing resources, and reporting final benefits.
Pool "Fixed Asset Ledger" — IT system recording the capitalised asset.
Pool "Capital Portfolio Management System" — IT system holding the project
record, budget, and portfolio reporting.

2. Pool properties

Pool "Project Organisation" — white-box, single instance.
Pool "Fixed Asset Ledger" — black-box, System = true, single instance.
Pool "Capital Portfolio Management System" — black-box, System = true,
single instance.

3. Layout

Top to bottom:
1. Project Organisation (white-box)
2. Fixed Asset Ledger
3. Capital Portfolio Management System

4. Lane contents in flow order (Project Organisation)

Finance lane:
  Message start event "Handover acceptance confirmed — received from
  Commission & Hand Over"
  User task "Identify assets for capitalisation"
  User task "Determine capitalisation date and cost components"
  Service task "Create asset records in Fixed Asset Ledger"
  Service task "Post capitalisation journal entries to Fixed Asset Ledger"
  Intermediate message catch event "Asset records confirmed by Fixed Asset
  Ledger"
  User task "Reconcile project costs against capitalised amounts"
  Exclusive gateway "Reconciliation complete?"
    - branch "Discrepancy found": Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
      Reconciliation Resolved" (standard loop) containing, in order:
      User task "Investigate cost discrepancy", User task "Adjust
      capitalisation entries", Service task "Repost corrected entries to
      Fixed Asset Ledger"
      (exits subprocess)
    - branch "Reconciliation clear": (continues to exclusive merge gateway
      "Reconciliation complete")
  Exclusive merge gateway "Reconciliation complete"
  User task "Expense non-capitalisable project costs"
  User task "Prepare final project cost report"
  Service task "Submit final cost report to Capital Portfolio Management
  System"

Project Management lane:
  User task "Confirm all contractor and vendor obligations discharged"
  User task "Release project resources and close purchase orders"
  Service task "Update project status to closed in Capital Portfolio
  Management System"
  User task "Conduct project close-out review and capture lessons learned"
  Service task "Record lessons learned in Capital Portfolio Management
  System"
  User task "Prepare benefits realisation baseline"
  Service task "Lodge benefits realisation baseline in Capital Portfolio
  Management System"
  End event "Asset capitalised and project formally closed"

5. Edge-mounted (boundary) events

Interrupting timer boundary event on Expanded Subprocess "Repeat Until
Reconciliation Resolved" — label "Reconciliation deadline exceeded" —
triggers End event "Escalation raised — reconciliation unresolved".

6. Connectors

Sequence flows: work begins in the Finance lane with the message start
event, proceeds through asset identification, cost determination, asset
record creation, journal posting, confirmation wait, and reconciliation;
the reconciliation gateway branches to the loop subprocess on discrepancy
or continues directly to the merge gateway on a clear result; after the
merge, Finance completes cost expensing, the final cost report, and
submission to Capital Portfolio Management System; flow then passes to
the Project Management lane for contractor discharge confirmation,
resource release and purchase order closure, project status update,
close-out review, lessons-learned recording, benefits baseline
preparation, and lodgement, ending at the close event.

Message flows:
Fixed Asset Ledger → Finance lane: Service task "Create asset records in
Fixed Asset Ledger" (asset record creation confirmation).
Fixed Asset Ledger → Finance lane: Intermediate message catch event
"Asset records confirmed by Fixed Asset Ledger" (confirmation of posted
records).
Finance lane → Fixed Asset Ledger: Service task "Post capitalisation
journal entries to Fixed Asset Ledger" (capitalisation journal).
Finance lane → Fixed Asset Ledger: Service task "Repost corrected entries
to Fixed Asset Ledger" (corrected journal entries).
Finance lane → Capital Portfolio Management System: Service task "Submit
final cost report to Capital Portfolio Management System" (final project
cost report).
Project Management lane → Capital Portfolio Management System: Service
task "Update project status to closed in Capital Portfolio Management
System" (project closure status).
Project Management lane → Capital Portfolio Management System: Service
task "Record lessons learned in Capital Portfolio Management System"
(lessons learned record).
Project Management lane → Capital Portfolio Management System: Service
task "Lodge benefits realisation baseline in Capital Portfolio Management
System" (benefits realisation baseline).

7. Data objects

Data Object "Capitalisation Schedule" — written by User task "Determine
capitalisation date and cost components"; read by Service task "Create
asset records in Fixed Asset Ledger".
Data Object "Asset Records" — written by Service task "Create asset
records in Fixed Asset Ledger"; read by User task "Reconcile project
costs against capitalised amounts".
Data Object "Project Cost Report" — written by User task "Prepare final
project cost report"; read by Service task "Submit final cost report to
Capital Portfolio Management System".
Data Object "Lessons Learned Register" — written by User task "Conduct
project close-out review and capture lessons learned"; read by Service
task "Record lessons learned in Capital Portfolio Management System".
Data Object "Benefits Realisation Baseline" — written by User task
"Prepare benefits realisation baseline"; read by Service task "Lodge
benefits realisation baseline in Capital Portfolio Management System".

This subprocess converts all project expenditure into fixed-asset records
and ledger entries, expenses any non-capitalisable costs, and formally
closes the project in the portfolio system. It reconciles total project
spend against capitalised value, captures lessons learned, and establishes
the benefits realisation baseline. On completion, the asset is live on the
fixed-asset register and the project is closed, concluding the Concept to
Commissioning value chain.
```
